shortDesc: Biarkan ketenangan hutan tropis Ubud memeluk seluruh panca indera Anda. Dengan dek kolam renang privat yang menghadap rerimbunan hijau dan sentuhan arsitektur khas Bali, villa 3 kamar ini adalah tempat di mana pikiran Anda menemukan kedamaian mutlak.
description: Biarkan ketenangan hutan tropis Ubud memeluk seluruh panca indera Anda. Dengan dek kolam renang privat yang menghadap rerimbunan hijau dan sentuhan arsitektur khas Bali, villa 3 kamar ini adalah tempat di mana pikiran Anda menemukan kedamaian mutlak.
fullDesc:
Dengarkan simfoni alam hutan hujan tropis Ubud yang menenangkan saat kabut pagi perlahan menyingkap keindahan lembah hijau di hadapan Anda. St. Lau adalah oasis ketenangan abadi bagi jiwa yang merindukan relaksasi mendalam.

Menghadirkan 3 kamar tidur bernuansa hangat dengan lantai kayu jati dan balkon privat, villa ini menyatu selaras dengan alam sekitarnya. Dek kolam renang pribadi menjadi tempat meditasi sempurna untuk melepas penat seraya menghirup udara pegunungan yang sejuk dan bersih.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Pengalaman menginap yang begitu indah dan magis! Terletak di kawasan yang sangat hening dan damai. Staf villa begitu penuh perhatian dan melayani kami dengan tulus dari hati. Kami merasa benar-benar dimanjakan!"

Hanya beberapa menit dari pusat kebudayaan Ubud dan Hutan Monyet yang legendaris, St. Lau memberikan Anda keseimbangan sempurna antara petualangan budaya dan kedamaian retret privat.

descriptionSections.body:
Find your perfect Ubud escape at Villa St. Lau, a private sanctuary hidden in tropical greenery just minutes from Ubud’s heart.

Unwind in open living spaces, cool off in a sparkling pool, soak in the outdoor bathtub, or enjoy sunset BBQs and friendly billiard matches under the stars.

With full amenities and caring staff, Villa St. Lau is where you can slow down, reconnect, and let Bali cast its spell.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Step into your private sanctuary at St. Lau; a villa designed for slow mornings, sun-drenched afternoons and dreamy Bali nights. Slide open the doors to a sparkling pool wrapped in lush gardens and enjoy thoughtful amenities at every turn.

Inside, bright pavilions host a cozy lounge with TV and billiard table, plus a fully equipped kitchen and dining area for lazy breakfasts or fresh juices after a day out. Fire up the BBQ for a fun evening with friends, or if you’d rather not cook, we can arrange meals for you or point you to Ubud’s best cafés.

The bedrooms are private and tranquil, with soft linens on king beds that can be converted to twins on request, TVs, en-suite bathrooms and calming views of the surrounding greenery, perfect for both parents and kids. Two of the bathrooms share an outdoor bathtub and shower, ideal for a relaxing soak or a playful starlit bath time with little ones.

With daily cleaning included, all that’s left is to slow down, reconnect, and let Bali work its magic.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request 
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

name: Balangan Cliff Villa – Iconic 5BR Cliff-Edge Oceanfront Estate

reviews.name: Domenic
reviews.comment: The view is truly stunning, the private beach access is lovely, and breakfast at the resort restaurant is convenient and delicious. Unfortunately, numerous shortcomings marred the stay: check-in was delayed (3 p.m. instead of 2 p.m.), there were stains on the bed and sun loungers, the rain shower did not work properly, the oven was unusable, the pool pump had to be activated manually, the water dispenser was hygienically questionable, and the refrigerator was dirty. The main bathroom upstairs flooded. There is no window, just an open recess, which makes it extremely hot. The house looks like it needs renovating. The outdoor wooden floor is outdated, with holes and nails (risk of injury). The villa is located in the middle of a resort. Arrival was confusing, and the manager was not very motivated. No Uber/taxi pick-ups allowed in front of the resort. Not enough coffee capsules (10/day) for the whole group. The cleaning staff were friendly, but had to stay for 3 hours according to the instructions. Unfortunately, the value for money is not right. We cannot recommend the villa.
reviews.originalComment: Die Aussicht ist wirklich grandios, der private Strandzugang schön und das Frühstück im Resort-Restaurant praktisch und lecker. Leider trüben zahlreiche Mängel den Aufenthalt: Check-in verspätet (15 statt 14 Uhr), Flecken auf Bett und Sonnenliegen, Regendusche funktionierte nicht richtig, Backofen nicht nutzbar, Poolpumpe musste manuell aktiviert werden, Wasserspender hygienisch fragwürdig, Kühlschrank verschmutzt. Im Hauptbad oben kam es zu Überflutungen, es gibt kein Fenster, nur eine offene Aussparung, dadurch extrem warm. Haus wirkt renovierungsbedürftig, Außenholzboden veraltet mit Löchern und Nägeln (Verletzungsgefahr). Die Villa liegt mitten in einem Resort, Ankunft war verwirrend, Manager wenig motiviert. Vor dem Resort keine Grab-/Taxi-Abfahrt erlaubt. Kaffeekapseln (10/Tag) für die ganze Gruppe zu wenig. Reinigungspersonal freundlich, musste aber laut Vorgabe 3 Stunden bleiben. Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis passt leider nicht, können die Villa nicht empfehlen.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Domenic, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re pleased to hear you enjoyed the magnificent views, private beach access, and the convenience of having the resort and restaurant nearby.
Just to clarify, the standard check-in time is 2 PM. As you arrived earlier, the villa was still being prepared. Luggage can be dropped off from 12 PM, but the villa may not yet be ready as the housekeeping team needs sufficient time to prepare it properly.
Regarding the other concerns mentioned, unfortunately, none were raised during your stay. Had they been brought to our attention, the team would have been happy to check and assist where possible. Following your feedback, the items mentioned have been checked and are currently in good condition.
As the villa is located within a resort, certain resort-wide policies apply, including arrangements for online transportation and guest pick-ups, which we kindly ask guests to respect. The villa also provides 10 coffee pods per day for up to 10 guests; this is the standard daily provision and is not unlimited.
Thank you again for your feedback. We’ll continue to maintain the villa carefully and work to provide a good quality experience for our guests.

reviews.name: Leilana
reviews.comment:
Not what we expected. Yes, the views were amazing, but there was quite a bit of confusion with everything else. 
This house is located on another resort, Biu Biu, which is not clearly disclosed when booking. This makes it convenient if you want to eat at the restaurant (no other restaurants are close by), but that is the extent because Biu Biu won’t help you. I had conflicting information regarding using their shuttle bus to the beach - we were informed we could not use it, but another person at a sister property told us we could use it. 
The upstairs master has open windows (no glass), so it’s constantly warm and you need to keep the doors close if you want the a/c to work.
The hot water was inconsistent at best with a max of 5 minutes before going cold. 
The people who managed the property were nice but only responsive during certain hours of the day, which makes it difficult if something came up in the evening. 
Not worth the money. We would not stay here again.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Leilana, we’re sorry to hear that your stay did not fully meet your expectations. While guests may enjoy the convenience of the nearby restaurant and beachfront surroundings, we would like to clarify that the villa is independently managed and is not operated by Biu Biu. Therefore, their services, facilities, and access policies may differ from those of the villa. All available facilities and services included with your stay are communicated by our team, and we kindly recommend referring to the information provided by our team, as policies at other properties may not apply to our villa.
The upstairs master bedroom is also shown clearly in the listing photos. As with any air-conditioned room, especially in a tropical climate, keeping doors and windows closed while using the air conditioning is necessary to maintain a comfortable temperature. Regarding the hot water, our team inspected the system and confirmed that it was functioning properly during the stay. We would have been happy to investigate further had we been informed of any issues while you were at the villa.
Regarding communication, during nighttime hours, responses may occasionally take longer, but our contact number and Airbnb messaging remain available, and we always do our best to respond as quickly as possible whenever assistance is needed.
Thank you again for sharing your feedback. We value guest comments as they help us continue improving our service. At the same time, we kindly encourage guests to review the villa details, facilities, and tropical setting carefully before booking to ensure expectations are aligned with the experience we provide. Thank you.

reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Mr. Johannes,
Thank you for taking the time to review. We are sorry that your stay did not meet your expectations.
We also apologize for any inconvenience you experienced during the check-in or check-out process. We have recorded your feedback and will follow up with the relevant team so that our service can be better in the future.

reviews.name: Jocelyn
reviews.comment:
The house is perched at the top of a cliff and offers stunning sunset views. The size of the property is very large and there is ample space in each  bedroom and bathroom. The housekeeping staff and villa manager are very nice. The chef service is wonderful though expensive and there was no choice in menu.
The property requires maintenance and renovation and is very dated.  For this price, the property should be in much better condition.  Most of the bedrooms have no night tables and lack furniture. The living room sofas look very old and are not clean. 
The master bathroom has two giant holes as windows with no cover. Since this bathroom faces the nearby restaurant, it is not possible to shower since there are no closable windows or curtains.  We also saw lizards in this bathroom as the holes are huge and allow animals and insects to crawl in.
The property does not allow Grab or Gojek pick up. This is a huge problem with suitcases and elderly or kids. Not safe and not convenient.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Jocelyn,
Thank you for your feedback and for taking the time to share your experience.

We appreciate your comments regarding the villa condition; however, the property is presented as shown in the listing, and the villa is cleaned and maintained daily by our housekeeping team.
With regard to transportation, ride-hailing services such as Grab and Gojek have restrictions in the area due to local transportation regulations, which we are required to respect. Our team is always happy to assist with arranging alternative transport options when needed.
Thank you again for your feedback. We appreciate your comments and will continue working to provide the best possible guest experience.

reviews.originalComment: Nous avons été très déçus par notre séjour dans cette maison. Aucun équipement digne de ce nom à l’intérieur, tout est basique et minimaliste. reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Simon,
We’re disappointed to read your review, as the amenities and facilities you mentioned are clearly described in the villa’s listing. We always strive to keep everything in proper working order and to address any concerns promptly during our guests’ stay.

The showers generally have normal pressure, but we’ll check them again to ensure everything is in good order. Bali’s tropical climate, particularly in a beachfront setting, can naturally feel warmer and more humid even with good ventilation. Most of our guests understand and enjoy the Bali sun, though we’ll reassess how we can further enhance this aspect and the overall guest experience in the future.
We’re always open to feedback and improvement, but we do hope reviews reflect what is actually advertised and provided. Thank you.

shortDesc: Tataplah cakrawala Samudra Hindia yang membentang tanpa batas tepat di depan mata Anda. Bertengger megah di atas tebing kapur Balangan, estate 5 kamar tidur ini menyuguhkan kemegahan matahari terbenam spektakuler dan akses pantai eksklusif yang tak terlupakan.
description: Tataplah cakrawala Samudra Hindia yang membentang tanpa batas tepat di depan mata Anda. Bertengger megah di atas tebing kapur Balangan, estate 5 kamar tidur ini menyuguhkan kemegahan matahari terbenam spektakuler dan akses pantai eksklusif yang tak terlupakan.
fullDesc:
Berdirilah di tepi tebing kapur megah dan rasakan energi magis samudra lepas yang terbentang sejauh mata memandang. Balangan Cliff Villa adalah mahakarya oceanfront yang dirancang bagi mereka yang hanya menginginkan pengalaman terbaik di Bali.

Dengan 5 kamar tidur megah yang menghadap langsung ke lautan biru, kolam renang infinity di bibir tebing, dan akses tangga eksklusif menuju pantai pasir putih di bawahnya, setiap momen di sini terasa seperti lukisan hidup. Saksikan para peselancar menari di atas ombak kelas dunia saat matahari terbenam mewarnai langit dengan palet jingga keemasan.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Pemandangannya benar-benar mencengangkan dan tidak ada tandingannya di Bali! Menikmati sarapan sambil menatap lautan lepas dan berjalan langsung ke pantai pribadi membuat seluruh keluarga kami takjub. Tempat yang sangat berkesan!"

Manjakan diri Anda dengan kemewahan tanpa batas dan layanan privat berkelas tinggi di atas puncak tebing paling ikonik di Uluwatu.

descriptionSections.body:
Embark on an exquisite 5-Bedroom Cliff-Top Villa with Breathtaking Views, a spacious haven perched on a cliff in the Balangan area.

What to expect :
- Exclusive access to the private beach of the Biu Biu complex
- Modern and elegant design
- Unobstructed sea views and spacious pool overlooking the cliff

The villa is fully equipped and staffed so you don't have to worry about a thing!

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to our villa, an exquisite cliff-top retreat in the breathtaking Balangan area. 
With 5 bedrooms, including 2 upstairs bedrooms with en suite bathrooms, this villa promises a luxurious escape for you.

Step inside to discover a private kitchen attached to a charming dining area, perfect for enjoying delicious meals with loved ones. 
The semi-open living area seamlessly connects to the inviting pool area, where you can soak up the sun and take in the breathtaking ocean views.

Relax and unwind in the spacious 10 x 5-meter swimming pool, surrounded by lush greenery and overlooking the azure waters of the Indian Ocean.

Additionally, the villa offers a patio with ocean views, providing the ideal spot for enjoying a morning coffee or evening cocktail while soaking in the beauty of the surroundings.

As a guest of the villa, you'll enjoy exclusive access to the private beach of the Biu Biu complex, where you can unwind on the secluded shores and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of Bali's coastline.

Experience the ultimate in luxury and relaxation at our villa, where every detail is designed to ensure an unforgettable stay.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The whole villa will be available for you with complete privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:
• Free welcome drink
• Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
• Bath & Pool towels for each guests
• Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
• Safety box
• Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
• Airport transfer
• Car rental (with/without driver)
• Bike rental
• Breakfast upon request
• Private cook
• Massages at the villa
• Nanny services
• Pool fence
• Laundry
• Restaurant bookings
• Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
• Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
• And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

reviews.hostResponse:
Thank you so much for your detailed feedback, Samantha. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the spacious villa, peaceful location, comfortable beds, and pool, and that our team was helpful and communicative throughout your stay.
Regarding the leaves around the yoga area and pool, the outdoor areas are cleaned regularly. As the villa is very open and surrounded by nature, wind can easily bring leaves and other natural debris back into the area, sometimes shortly after cleaning. The team will continue to pay close attention to these areas to keep them as clean as possible.
Your feedback regarding the outdoor furniture, cushions, and lighting has also been noted, and all the necessary updates have now been completed.

Further improvements are also being explored to enhance guests’ comfort and overall experience during their stay.

reviews.name: Karmorreya
reviews.comment: I wouldn’t stay here again it’s nothing like the pictures it’s a lot smaller. The pool was dirty along with the lounge chairs that had needed serious maintenance they were all moldy and torn. Kitchen and family area had no ac and smelled so it was extremely hot and made coming together as a group hard plus no tv in the living room so basically it wasn’t even worth having. Can’t do the flowers in the pool so don’t book if that’s something you’re interested. The locals will wake you up every morning and bring by a graveyard really made things worse. Location is terrible the smallest road and parking imaginable. The Grab app that’s used for rides and food doesn’t even have this address listed so we were continuously having to walk do the driveway to meet them. Plus the drivers all would point out the graveyard and ask if we know what it was. The staff on site spoke little English and it was really hard having a conversation with them. Overall I wouldn’t stay here again.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Karmorreya, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We were a little surprised to see these concerns mentioned in your review, as they weren’t brought to our attention during your stay. We’re always happy to help if anything comes up, and our team can be reached through Airbnb or WhatsApp. Our local manager is also nearby and available to assist whenever needed.
To clarify a few points from your review, the villa amenities and other information is as per mentioned in the listing. It does not include a TV in the living room or air-conditioning in the shared areas, as reflected in the listing photos and Airbnb description. Floating flower decorations are not provided, as they may impact the pool filtration system. Regarding directions, apps such as Grab may not always accurately show newer or private villa locations, but we are always happy to assist with directions or arrange transport when required.
The villa is situated within a villa complex in Bali and is surrounded by a natural Balinese environment, which is part of the authentic local experience. All important details are clearly communicated before arrival and we remain available throughout each stay for any support needed.
While we always welcome feedback and suggestions for improvement, we also hope that everyone visiting Bali takes the time to appreciate the island’s unique culture, natural surroundings, and local way of life, while respecting that the experience here may be different from what they are accustomed to elsewhere.

shortDesc: Rasakan sensasi melayang di atas kanopi lembah Sungai Ayung dari infinity pool spektakuler villa 5 kamar ini. Udara pegunungan Ubud yang sejuk dan suara alam yang menenteramkan akan memulihkan energi tubuh dan jiwa Anda secara menyeluruh.
description: Rasakan sensasi melayang di atas kanopi lembah Sungai Ayung dari infinity pool spektakuler villa 5 kamar ini. Udara pegunungan Ubud yang sejuk dan suara alam yang menenteramkan akan memulihkan energi tubuh dan jiwa Anda secara menyeluruh.
fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda berada di surga tersembunyi di mana infinity pool pribadi Anda membentang dramatis di atas kanopi hijau lembah Sungai Ayung. Villa Angkasa adalah tempat perlindungan megah bagi mereka yang mencari keagungan alam Ubud dalam balutan kemewahan modern.

Dirancang untuk rombongan besar dan keluarga, villa 5 kamar tidur ini memiliki paviliun ruang tamu dan ruang makan terbuka yang luas dengan tiang-tiang kayu ulin kokoh. Pemandangan lembah sungai yang spektakuler dapat dinikmati dari setiap kamar, menghadirkan kedamaian mendalam setiap kali Anda membuka mata.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Rumah yang luar biasa indah persis seperti di foto! Pemandangan lembah Sungai Ayung yang spektakuler dan keramahan staf lokal kami membuat liburan keluarga kami di Ubud menjadi pengalaman yang tak terlupakan seumur hidup."

Manjakan diri Anda dengan layanan spa in-villa, sarapan lezat yang disiapkan hangat setiap pagi, dan kedamaian spiritual yang hanya bisa ditemukan di dataran tinggi Ubud.

descriptionSections.body:
Discover Villa Angkasa, a breathtaking retreat in Ubud, where modern comforts meet Bali’s natural charm.

What you’ll love:

- Stylish, high-end interiors designed for comfort and elegance
- Prime location, just minutes from Monkey Forest, Ubud Center, The Blanco Renaissance Museum, and more!
- Expansive pool with a tasteful patio, perfect for soaking in the blue sky and lush surroundings

Fully equipped and staffed, Villa Angkasa lets you unwind and make the most of your Bali getaway.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Nestled in the heart of Ubud, Villa Angkasa is a stylish 5-bedroom sanctuary where modern luxury meets Bali’s natural beauty. This spacious retreat is perfect for families or friends seeking a private escape surrounded by lush landscapes, yet just minutes from Ubud’s vibrant center.

Designed for tranquility and comfort, the villa centers around a sparkling infinity pool and generous outdoor spaces. Sleek modern lines and natural textures complement open-air living areas, while shaded lounges and garden pathways invite slow, relaxed moments.

Unwind by the infinity pool, stretch out on sun-kissed daybeds, or relax beneath gently swaying umbrellas. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors in every suite create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living, framing beautiful views of the surrounding greenery and rice fields.

Inside, five beautifully appointed ensuite bedrooms blend comfort with contemporary style, each featuring plush king-size beds, smart TVs, and sleek private bathrooms. The master bedroom also features a relaxing bathtub, perfect for unwinding after a day exploring Ubud.

At the heart of the villa is the open-plan living area, styled with sculptural furnishings, warm wood accents, and earthy tones. Filled with natural light, the space flows effortlessly into a fully equipped modern kitchen—ideal for casual breakfasts or relaxed evening meals. For deeper relaxation, indulge in a soothing in-villa massage while surrounded by peaceful tropical scenery.

With thoughtful design, full amenities, and a prime Ubud location, Villa Angkasa offers more than just a stay, it’s an experience for a memorable Bali escape.

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda membuka mata di pagi hari, disambut oleh semilir angin sepoi tropis yang bertiup lembut melintasi hamparan sawah hijau zamrud Pererenan. Di hadapan Anda, laguna renang pribadi berkilau jernih di bawah sinar mentari pagi, mengundang Anda untuk memulai hari dengan kesegaran yang hakiki.

Villa Habitas bukan sekadar tempat menginap—ini adalah tempat perlindungan jiwa di mana setiap detik terasa begitu berharga. Menghadirkan 4 kamar tidur berdesain arsitektur kontemporer yang elegan, kasur king-size yang luar biasa empuk, serta paviliun semi-terbuka yang mengalir alami, villa ini dirancang sempurna untuk menyatukan keluarga dan sahabat dalam kehangatan sejati.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Villa ini benar-benar luar biasa! Lokasi sempurna, dekat dengan kafe artisan dan spa, sangat aman dan nyaman untuk keluarga. Staf villa sangat hangat, ramah, dan penuh perhatian membaca setiap kebutuhan kami. Kami tidak sabar untuk kembali lagi!"

Ketika Anda memilih tinggal di Villa Habitas, Anda mengamankan privasi eksklusif tanpa cela di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali. Nikmati kemudahan berjalan kaki ke deretan restoran trendi Pererenan, sambil tetap menikmati kedamaian mutlak di sanctuary privat Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Discover Villa Habitas, a brand new four bedroom stunning villa nestled within a serene landscape in Pererenan.

This architectural masterpiece seamlessly blends minimalistic design with luxury amenities, providing a tranquil escape for those seeking refined aesthetics and functionality.

What to expect:
- High quality furnishing
- Close to the beach and all the best cafes and restaurants
- Contemporary & minimalistic design

Our villa is fully equipped and staffed for your comfort.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Upon entering the property, you're welcomed by an impressive, grand spiral staircase situated at the heart of a spacious living area.

This living space features a spacious and cozy seating area, complete with a TV equipped with Netflix for those rainy days. Its decor is Mediterranean-inspired, emphasizing a minimalist and sleek design.

Adjacent to the living room is a massive wooden dining table, perfect for savoring the delicacies of the Balinese cuisine.

A fully-equipped kitchen is also on hand for preparing any meal, or you can opt to have someone cook for you. Please inform us if you'd like to arrange a dinner with an in-home chef!

One of the highlight of Villa Habitas is its outdoor area. Boasting a lagoon-shaped, crystal clear pool, it's the ideal spot to bask in the Balinese sunshine! Adjacent to this pool is a spacious sunken lounge, an ideal setting for group gatherings and enjoying a drink for sunset.
The outdoor area also boasts several sunbeds scattered around the pool as well as another dining table, allowing for breakfast, lunch, or dinner in an outdoor setting.
Villa Habitas also features a spacious garden area.

The villa offers an unobstructed view of rice fields, providing the real Balinese experience.

Every bedroom at Villa Habitas comes with an en-suite bathroom, spacious closets featuring a safety box, and a king-sized bed. Of the four bedrooms in Villa Habitas, one is situated on the ground floor, while the other three, including the master bedroom with an added bathtub, are on the first floor.

Villa Habitas also enjoys large parking spaces which can accomodate up to 2 cars and scooters. It is located in a quiet street of Pererenan and trendy cafes, restaurants and bars are at walking distance of the villa.
You can be at the Pererenan beach and in the center of canggu in a short drive.

Our villa is fully equipped and manned by a team of committed professionals, eager to ensure your stay is truly memorable.

Book Villa Habitas now for an elegant escape!

reviews.name: August
reviews.comment: Ayu was amazing and took great care of us the whole stay. We had stained sheets at check in and she sorted it right away. Beds and pillows are really comfortable, towels and sheets were spotless and smelled great. Nice touches too, welcome juice and watermelon, AC in every room, earplugs by the bed, optional daily cleaning. No coffee machine though, only a french press. Heads up if you travel with big luggage, the stairs to the upper floor make it basically impossible to get a large suitcase up, even our small one was a struggle. Also one of the pool deck boards isn’t fastened at all, no screws holding it, it moves when you step on it and my foot got caught once. There are also raised screw heads you really don’t want to step on barefoot, we did. The steps flex when you walk on them and the stair edges are splintering. Hot water runs on a small solar tank so some evenings there was no warm shower, and mosquitoes get in through the door gaps. Fix these and it’s easily 5 stars.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear August,
Thank you for your feedback. Our team has thoroughly checked the property and ensured that everything is now in good working order for our guests’ safety and comfort.
We truly appreciate your stay and look forward to welcoming you back for an even better experience!

reviews.name: Abdoul Kader
reviews.comment: Top
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you Abdoul, we can't wait to welcome you again!

reviews.name: Chopey
reviews.comment:
Overall, we had a pleasant stay. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always willing to help. The villa was clean, and the location itself is nice and peaceful.
That said, the property would benefit from some regular maintenance. While it looks beautiful in the photos, certain areas—especially the pool and parts of the villa—are beginning to show signs of wear. Keeping up with routine maintenance would help the property live up to the impression it gives online.
One thing to note is the staircase, which was quite difficult to use. Going up and down was uncomfortable and could be improved for both convenience and safety.
The location is enjoyable if you have your own transport, but relying on taxis can be inconvenient due to availability and access.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay thanks to the excellent staff and clean accommodation. With a bit more attention to maintenance, this could easily be an outstanding place to stay.

fullDesc:
Izinkan diri Anda melarikan diri dari kebisingan dunia dan melangkah ke dalam oase romantis yang didedikasikan sepenuhnya untuk Anda berdua. Tersembunyi di sudut paling tenang Pererenan, Tranquil Sanctuary menawarkan kemewahan intim yang jarang ditemukan.

Setiap sudut villa 1 kamar tidur ini memancarkan ketenangan. Dari kolam renang pribadi yang jernih, kamar mandi terbuka bernuansa spa batu alam, hingga kamar tidur berpenyejuk udara dengan linen premium, Anda akan merasakan bagaimana tubuh dan pikiran Anda seketika rileks.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Villa yang luar biasa cantik, sangat tenang, bersih, dan komunikasi tim tuan rumah sangat cepat dan membantu. Pengalaman menginap yang benar-benar memulihkan energi kami!"

Hanya beberapa menit berjalan kaki dari kafe artisan dan pantai Pererenan yang memesona, tempat ini adalah kanvas sempurna untuk merajut kenangan cinta terindah Anda di Bali.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Villa Solani, a cozy 1-bedroom villa nestled in the heart of Pererenan. Just 8 minutes from the beach by scooter, this tropical escape is ideal for those craving comfort, privacy, and a slower pace.

Surrounded by greenery, the villa offers a private pool, open-plan living, and calming natural finishes throughout. 

A perfect hideaway for couples or solo travelers, Villa Solani is your serene home base in one of Bali’s most laid-back corners.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
This tropical 1BR villa combines modern design with lush surroundings. Warm wood accents, cascading greenery, and an open-plan layout create a seamless flow from indoors to the private pool. Perfect for slow mornings and laid-back afternoons in the heart of Pererenan.

Inside, the villa features a warm, open-plan layout with a sunken lounge, built-in seating, and soft neutral tones that create a cozy yet refined feel. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors flood the space with natural light and open to lush garden views, while the fully equipped kitchen with rich makes it easy to enjoy anything from home-cooked meals to casual drinks. For added convenience, a semi-outdoor bathroom is located just beside the kitchen—perfect for a quick rinse after a swim.

The bedroom is a serene escape, featuring a king-sized bed, soft natural tones, and views of tropical greenery through sliding glass doors. Thoughtfully designed for comfort, it includes an ensuite bathroom, smart TV, and thoughtful touches throughout, it’s designed for restful nights and slow, sunny mornings.

Daily cleaning is included, so you can fully unwind without lifting a finger. Whether you're here to surf, explore, or simply relax by the pool, we’ve got you covered.

Book your stay and make your Bali getaway truly unforgettable.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Full privacy and reserved for guests.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny Services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more! 

Please note : The stairs in the villa are slightly steep. Most guests have no issue, but they may not be suitable for those with mobility concerns or very young children. Please take care when using them.

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

As a group with four children, we found the space incredibly well thought-out and comfortable for family living.

Overall, a fantastic stay and a property we would absolutely recommend to other families looking for a stylish and relaxing base in Canggu.

description: Biarkan diri Anda tenggelam dalam pesona hidup tropis modern di jantung Canggu. Paviliun terbuka yang lapang, kolam renang berkilau, dan 4 kamar tidur mewah menanti Anda dan orang-orang tercinta untuk merayakan momen berharga bersama.
fullDesc:
Selamat datang di Casa Kameeyla, di mana energi dinamis Canggu berpadu mesra dengan ketenangan rumah peristirahatan tropis yang privat. Begitu Anda melangkahkan kaki melewati pintu masuk, suasana riang dan elegan seketika menyambut Anda.

Villa 4 kamar tidur ini dirancang untuk menciptakan kebersamaan yang hangat. Kolam renang pribadi yang berkilau diapit dek berjemur yang luas, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka menjadi tempat ideal untuk berbagi tawa, bersantap bersama, atau sekadar bersantai menikmati koktail sore.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Casa Kameeyla melampaui seluruh ekspektasi kami! Sangat bersih tanpa cela, lokasinya sangat strategis di pusat Canggu, dan stafnya sangat responsif. Pilihan terbaik untuk liburan rombongan!"

Jadikan liburan Anda di Canggu penuh gaya dan kenyamanan tanpa kompromi. Semua kafe terbaik, butik fashion, dan pantai selancar hanya sepelemparan batu dari sanctuary pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Searching for the ideal accommodation in Canggu? 

Casa Kameelya is a brand-new villa with four bedrooms, conveniently situated within walking distance to the beach and popular cafes, bars, and restaurants. 

With its high ceiling, expansive windows, and a design that blends modern amenities with Mediterranean accents, Casa Kameelya is an excellent choice for large families or group. 

The villa is fully staffed and equipped, ensuring you can relax and enjoy your stay without any concerns.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Casa Kameelya is a brand-new, stylish villa featuring four bedrooms—three with king-size beds and one with twin beds—each equipped with a private bathroom, ample closet space, and secure safes.

One of the standout features of Casa Kameelya is its expansive outdoor area, which is quite rare for villas in this region. The exterior boasts a large, crystal-clear swimming pool, sunbathing spots, and spacious seating areas, all set within a generous garden that’s perfect for children to enjoy.

At the heart of the villa is a bright, airy living space with soaring ceilings that flow effortlessly into the poolside through sleek sliding doors, achieving a perfect harmony between indoor and outdoor living. For moments of privacy and coziness, the space can be enclosed with ease. Relax on the plush sofa and enjoy entertainment on the large smart TV with Netflix,  perfect for entertainment on rainy days. The room also features an elegant dining area, combining comfort with sophisticated style for a truly inviting experience.

Next to the living room is a well-equipped kitchen, ideal for cooking your own meals or arranging for a chef to cater to your culinary desires. Don’t hesitate to ask about our chef services to enhance your stay.

Conveniently located in the heart of Berawa, the villa is just a short walk from the beach and some of Bali’s trendiest cafes and restaurants. 

This villa is a true luxurious retreat for large groups or families looking to enjoy a memorable holiday on the island of the gods.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The whole villa with complete privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- High Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

name: Luxe Beach Villa – Chic 3BR Coastal Hideaway Steps from Seminyak Beach

reviews.name: Felicia
reviews.comment:
I took my daughter and niece to Bali. Concierge arranged the airport pick up as well as the door to door transportation. The architecture and design of the Villa was beautiful. It wasn’t as new as I would have like but it was still really nice. The villa was clean. Beds were comfortable. Towels and washcloths smelled amazingly fresh. The outdoor shower was the Best. 
My only issue was  the main house sliding door would not latch nor lock. We reached out to the concierge who never responded and never came to fix the latch, therefore the villa was unlocked and not secured the whole time.
reviews.hostResponse:
Thank you for sharing your experience with us, Felicia. We’re glad to hear you enjoyed the villa and the arrangements made for your stay.
Regarding the concerns you mentioned, we believe our team did reach out to you, but we sincerely apologize if you felt the response was not as prompt as you would have liked. Response times can sometimes be a little slower at night. If you also reach out to us through Airbnb messaging, we can follow up with our team more directly.
We had noted both issues you mentioned, and we can confirm that both were fixed at the time of your checkout. We appreciate you bringing them to our attention and have made sure they were properly addressed.
Thank you again for staying with us.

reviews.name: 萍萍
reviews.comment:
The villa's aesthetics are stunning at first glance. The high sloping roof and the large floor-to-ceiling glass windows create a sense of openness. The private pool is surrounded by tropical greenery. As soon as you walk into the yard, you are instantly enveloped by a relaxing holiday atmosphere. The view is full of greenery and clear pool water. Every photo you take is like an Instagram masterpiece.
The interior space is spacious and comfortable. The large sunken sofa in the living room is perfect for relaxing and lying down. The wooden roof is complemented by simple and elegant soft furnishings, creating a high-end and cozy feel. The dining and kitchen area is neat and functional. The host provides fruit and specially prepared drinks here. You can enjoy a drink and chat while enjoying the beautiful view of the pool. The atmosphere is great, and the privacy is also very well maintained. There is absolutely no need to worry about being disturbed. You wouldn't get tired of lying here all day.
The only minor drawback is that parking on the small road leading to the house is not particularly convenient. Otherwise, I really can't find any issues. The environment, design, comfort, and cleanliness are all impeccable. It's perfect for a relaxing holiday with friends and family. Next time I come, I will definitely choose this place again. Highly recommended for friends who want a slow-paced holiday!
reviews.originalComment:
别墅的颜值第一眼就被狠狠惊艳，挑高的斜顶+整面落地大玻璃，通透感直接拉满，热带绿植环绕私人泳池，走进院子瞬间就被满满的松弛度假感包围，满眼绿意+清透池水，拍照每一帧都像ins大片。
室内空间宽敞又舒适，下沉式大沙发客厅太适合放空躺卧，木质屋顶搭配简约侘寂风软装，质感高级又温馨；餐厨区域整洁好用，房东在这里备好水果和特调饮品，对着泳池美景小酌闲聊，氛围感直接拉满，私密性也做得非常好，完全不用担心被打扰。在这里躺上一整天都完全不会腻。
唯一小小的不足就是入户的小路停车不是特别方便，除此之外真的挑不出毛病，环境、设计、舒适度、整洁度都无可挑剔，太适合和朋友、家人一起来度假放松，下次来一定还会优先选择这里，强烈推荐给想要慢节奏度假的朋友们！
reviews.hostResponse: Hello 萍萍, thank you for your review. We’re happy to share that we’re making improvements to the villa to make every stay even more enjoyable. It would be a pleasure to host you again!

fullDesc:
Bayangkan berjalan kaki tanpa alas kaki di atas pasir pantai Seminyak yang hangat hanya dua menit setelah melangkah keluar dari villa Anda. Luxe Beach Villa menghadirkan impian liburan pesisir Bali yang sesungguhnya.

Menampilkan 3 kamar tidur mewah ber-AC dengan kamar mandi en-suite, ruang keluarga terbuka yang menghadap langsung ke kolam renang pribadi, dan tata cahaya hangat di malam hari, villa ini adalah perpaduan harmonis antara gaya hidup kosmopolitan Seminyak dan ketenangan privat.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Lokasi yang luar biasa langka—begitu dekat dengan pantai dan Ku De Ta, namun saat pintu ditutup, suasana di dalam villa begitu damai dan tenang. Pelayanan concierge dan kebersihan kamar tidur sangat mengesankan!"

Rasakan kemewahan berada di pusat magnet kuliner dan hiburan terbaik Bali dengan jaminan ketenangan dan privasi mutlak untuk Anda dan keluarga.

descriptionSections.body:
Discover Villa Vaya, a stylish and luxurious villa just a few minutes away from Batu Belig Beach. It offers the ultimate Bali retreat.

What you can look forward to:

- Prime location, close to the beach and great restaurants 
- tropical and minimalist design
- Fully serviced

Villa Vaya is fully furnished and staffed, ensuring a worry-free stay for you!

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Villa Vaya, a stylishly designed three-bedroom villa, is centrally locate retreat between Canggu and Seminyak, where luxury meets tranquility amidst Bali's top cafes and restaurants.

The spaciousness of our villas is unparalleled, providing a large seating area with a comfortable sofa and expansive bay windows that flood the villa with natural light throughout the day. Whether you're lounging in the vast living room or indulging in the tranquility of private bedrooms and en-suite bathrooms, every corner is a testament to refined living. 

The highlight of the property is its stunning swimming pool, ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring. The outdoor area also boasts a seating area, perfect for enjoying the warm Bali sunshine with a poll view.

The fully equipped kitchen provides all necessary utensils and amenities for preparing meals, or guests can opt for the convenience of having meals prepared for them. A dedicated dining area allows for gatherings dinners.

For those seeking the pinnacle of luxury, Villa Vaya promise an unforgettable experience where every element is designed to exceed expectations.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The whole villa will be available for you with complete privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:
-Free welcome drink
-Villa staff with daily cleaning
-Bath towels for each guests
-Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
-Safety boxes
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Breakfast upon request
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool Fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

fullDesc:
Tinggalkan hiruk-pikuk perkotaan dan temukan kembali kedamaian sejati di pesisir pantai Seseh yang masih alami. Tropical Elegance dirancang bagi jiwa-jiwa yang menghargai ketenangan, keasrian alam, dan sentuhan kemewahan yang bersahaja.

Villa 2 kamar tidur yang menawan ini menangkap semilir angin laut Samudra Hindia sepanjang hari. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih dikelilingi taman hijau, sementara interior berkonsep terbuka memberikan rasa lapang dan kebebasan yang membebaskan pikiran Anda dari segala beban.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Pengalaman menginap yang luar biasa brilian! Berada di desa Seseh yang tenang tanpa kemacetan, hanya beberapa langkah dari pantai berpasir hitam eksotis. Kami merasa sangat segar dan bugar setelah menginap di sini."

Saat Anda memilih Tropical Elegance, Anda memilih untuk merasakan Bali yang autentik, tenang, dan menyegarkan jiwa.

descriptionSections.body:
Escape to Halle, a peaceful haven in the tranquil Seseh area, just a short 100-meter walk to the beach.

What awaits you:

- Easy access to Seseh Beach and surrounding areas
- Stylish interiors and modern comforts
- Private pool and relaxing outdoor spaces

The villa is fully equipped and staffed so you can simply relax and enjoy your vacation.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Discover to Villa Halle, a peaceful haven located just a steps from the beach. Imagine waking up to the soothing sounds of nature, stepping out onto your private terrace, and diving into a sparkling pool. This stylish 2-bedroom villa blends modern luxury with tropical charm, offering the perfect space for relaxation and rejuvenation.

As you enter, you’ll be welcomed by a private pool surrounded by comfortable sun loungers, inviting you to soak up the Bali sun. The open-plan living area features a cozy sunken sofa and a TV, seamlessly connecting to the dining and kitchen areas—ideal for socializing or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The fully equipped kitchen offers modern appliances, making meal preparation easy and convenient.

Each bedroom is a private retreat, designed with comfort in mind, featuring plush beds, air conditioning, and ensuite bathrooms for added convenience.

Whether you're looking for a tranquil getaway or a base to explore the best of Bali, Villa Halle combines luxury with the perfect location. Discover the charm of Seseh, with its pristine beaches, local cafes, and lush surroundings just moments away.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Complete access and total privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Daily housekeeping
- Bath towels for each guests
- High Speed Wifi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages
- And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villas!

*Please note that there is nearby construction work, which may occasionally cause noise disturbance. This is expected to continue until the end of January 2027.*

reviews.name: Frederic
reviews.comment:
new house, good interior services...
large cool pool, with bubbles in the middle coming out of a suction mouth… amazing.
Young staff, very friendly
close to shops and restaurants although no pedestrian sidewalk (as is often the case in Bali)
The only downside is the noise from the works surrounding the house. It's written in the listing. I asked what the noise level was before booking: "It depends on the tools used but it's not too loud if you tolerate moderate noise." Okay for us, we'll book!!!! But no luck, the workers used a jackhammer, excavator, diesel compressor and sometimes a hammer. The land next door is being cleared so chainsaw all day.
it is therefore very noisy and just across the street from a slum where the very nice workers sleep. 
this rental will be perfect when the work is finished in several months or even years?
reviews.originalComment:
maison neuve , bonnes prestations intérieures…
grande piscine fraîche , avec des bulles au milieu sortant d’une bouche d’aspiration… étonnant.
personnels jeunes , très sympathiques
proche de commerces et de restaurants quoique pas de trottoir pour piétons (comme souvent à bali)
le seul bémol est le bruit des travaux qui entourent la maison. c’est écrit dans l’annonce. j ai demandé quel niveau de bruit avant de réserver :  « cela dépend des outils utilisés mais c’est pas trop fort si on tolère les bruits modérés. », ok pour nous on réserve!!!! mais pas de chance les ouvriers ont utilisé marteau piqueur, pelleteuse, compresseur diesel et parfois un marteau. le terrain à côté est en cours défrichage donc tronçonneuse toute la journée.
c’est donc très bruyant et juste en face d’un bidonville où dorment les ouvriers très gentils au demeurant.
cette location sera parfaite quand les travaux seront finis dans plusieurs mois voir années?
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Frederic,
Thank you for your review. We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed the villa, and the overall great location. Bali is rapidly developing in many areas, and while the nearby construction is unfortunately beyond our control, we truly appreciate your understanding. Noise levels can vary depending on the time of day, but it's generally minimal and not too disruptive from inside the villa. We're happy to know you still had a pleasant stay overall, and we’d be absolutely delighted to welcome you back again in the future.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Yellow Moon, a private villa in the heart of Southern Bali, delightfully secluded yet just minutes away from breathtaking beaches like Melasti; vibrant beach clubs such as Savaya and Sunday's Beach Club; and a world-class golf course. Soak in a tranquil oasis designed for ultimate unwinding. Spanning an expansive 300m², Yellow Moon charms with its abundance of tropical flora, a large pool, and an open airy layout.
Perfect for surfers, families or anyone seeking a peaceful Bali escape.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Step inside Yellow Moon, a stunning 3-bedroom villa cocooned in lush greenery of the tropics—a sanctuary where Balinese artistry and natural beauty meet modern design and luxury. Thoughtful details, from bold architectural lines and high ceilings to bespoke furnishings and carefully curated Balinese artifacts—creating a space bursting with character and soul that connects you to the land’s rich culture and heritage. The villa is impeccably outfitted with a full suite of modern conveniences—from a fully equipped kitchen, yoga and workout gear, kids and pool accessories to secure safety lockers and essential bathroom amenities including hair dryers, toiletries, bathrobes, and bath towels—ensuring your stay is effortless and comfortable.

The open-plan living area flows seamlessly through floor-to-ceiling glass doors onto a lively outdoor terrace and your very own private pool. Imagine basking in the golden Bali sun by the day, then gathering under the stars with a refreshing drink in hand as the gentle evening breeze whispers through the palms.

The fully equipped kitchen is perfect for those who love to cook, but if you prefer, our private chef is just a call away, ready to delight you with local flavours and international favourites, all served with a smile.

Each bedroom is a haven of comfort and style, featuring plush bedding and chic ensuite bathrooms that blend function with flair. The bathrooms offer a seamless blend of indoor luxury and the calming embrace of nature. Whether you’re curling up with a book indoors or entertaining friends or family poolside, Yellow Moon offers a versatile and inviting setting that feels like home, yet truly extraordinary.

Hanya beberapa menit dari tangga menuju pantai selancar Bingin dan deretan kafe organik trendi, CASA KĀYA adalah definisi sejati dari liburan berkelas yang santai.

descriptionSections.body:
Nestled in Bingin, CASA KĀYA is a chic 1-bedroom retreat designed for couples seeking romance and relaxation in a stylish setting.

This modern and elegantly styled villa, part of an exclusive residence, features open-plan living spaces and a stunning private pool as its serene centerpiece, surrounded by lush tropical greenery.

Located just a 3-minute ride from Dreamland Beach, it offers the perfect balance of privacy and access to Bali’s vibrant coastal life.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
**As with many popular areas in Bali, ongoing development is prevalent in Bingin. Please note that there is construction adjacent to and opposite the villa, which may result in daytime noise and potential privacy disturbances. This is expected to continue until the end of March 2027. However, to accommodate this inconvenience, our nightly rates have been significantly discounted**

CASA KĀYA is a brand-new 1-bedroom villa created for couples seeking style, comfort, and a touch of Bali magic. Just a 3-minute ride away from Dreamland Beach, cafés, and beach clubs this private hideaway blends modern design with tropical greenery for the ultimate retreat.

Wake up to garden views, enjoy a swim in your private pool, or unwind on the sunken sofa for a cozy movie night. With a fully equipped kitchen, dining area, and even a full bathroom, the villa is designed for both convenience and romance.

Upstairs, the airy bedroom with high ceilings and an ensuite bathroom offers a peaceful escape after days of exploring. With fast WiFi, Netflix, and seamless indoor-outdoor living, CASA KĀYA is the perfect setting for honeymoons, getaways, and everything in between.

📍 Nearby favorites:

- Dreamland Beach – 3 min
- Bingin Beach – 6 min
- Bambu Fitness – 5 min
- El Kabron – 3 min

Whether it’s beaches, sunsets, or Bali’s hidden gems, this villa is your private sanctuary to return to, wrapping every moment in style and serenity.

Overall the villa is very spacious and clean. 
The only downfalls I would point out is that we had minimal sun due to the buildings surrounding us, which meant the outdoor furniture is getting a bit mossy from not drying out properly. From the photos provided on the listing I was expecting sun, they may have been taken at a different time of the year as we had nowhere near as much sun as those photos. There was also an unpleasant smell that would come and go from some toilets - we ensured to keep the doors closed so this didn’t spread through the rooms. 
Overall we still really enjoyed our stay!

It took a few days before we felt that the air was not humid, bedding ++, but after a lot of air conditioning on the coldest setting to get rid of the moisture, it became much better! We enjoyed staying there, the only negative was that it was humid the first few days and that the laundry was a bit so-so. But it should be said that the hosts asked if we wanted laundry every day. All in all a great stay, the villa was very nice and just like the pictures. The host was very responsive and helpful!

Når vi ankom villaen var det veldig fuktig, spesielt i 2. etasje hvor det også luktet veldig kloak som kom fra det ene soverommet med bad. Lukten gikk ikke bort så vi endte med å ha døren lukket å ikke bruke soverommet.
Det tok noen dager før vi følte at det ikke var fuktig i lufta, sengetøy ++, men etter masse air condition på det kaldeste for å få bort fukten ble det mye bedre! Vi trivdes med å bo der, det eneste negativet var at det var fuktig de første dagene og at vasken var litt så som så. Men det skal sies at vertene spurte om vi ville ha vask hver dag. Alt i alt et bra opphold, villaen var veldig fin og akkurat som på bildene. Verten svarte raskt og var hjelpsom!

description: Bayangkan bersantai di tepi kolam yang teduh dinaungi pepohonan palem setelah seharian menikmati pantai Bingin. Villa 3 kamar tidur mewah ini memberikan kenyamanan paripurna bagi keluarga atau sahabat yang menginginkan relaksasi tingkat tinggi.
fullDesc:
Rasakan sensasi hidup mewah di pesisir Bingin di mana kenyamanan hotel bintang lima berpadu dengan kehangatan rumah pribadi. Luxury Tropical Bingin adalah perwujudan villa liburan yang diidamkan setiap pelancong cerdas.

Dikelilingi taman palem yang rimbun, villa 3 kamar tidur ini memiliki ruang keluarga berkonsep terbuka dengan furnitur desainer pilihan. Kasur berstandar premium di setiap kamar menjamin kualitas tidur yang nyenyak dan menyegarkan, sementara kolam renang berkilau menjadi pusat keceriaan sepanjang hari.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Penginapan yang fantastis! Lokasinya luar biasa dekat dengan kafe-kafe terbaik, restoran enak, dan butik belanja. Kolam renangnya sangat indah dan kasurnya luar biasa empuk. Rombongan kami sangat bahagia menginap di sini!"

Dekat dengan pantai-pantai ikonik Uluwatu dan Padang Padang, villa ini adalah gerbang terbaik Anda menuju gaya hidup pulau dewata yang sesungguhnya.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Padang Senang, a fresh and stylish 3-bedroom villa perfectly positioned in the heart of Uluwatu. 
Just steps from trendy cafés (Ours Café is literally next door!) and only a 10-minute walk to Padang Padang Beach, this villa blends chic tropical design with relaxed island living. 
Whether you’re here to surf, unwind, or explore, this is your home for effortless Bali days.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
🏡 Outdoor Area & Pool

Step into your own private paradise. A sparkling 10 × 3 m terrazzo-style pool sits at the center of the villa, surrounded by lush greenery and calming sunlight. Lounge on the sunbeds, cool off under the outdoor shower, or enjoy a quiet moment on the shaded patio — the ultimate backdrop for slow mornings and sunset downtime.

🛋️ Living Room

Designed for comfort and connection, the sunken living area offers a cozy spot to gather, watch a movie, or simply relax after a day at the beach. With a soft U-shaped sofa and natural textures throughout, it’s the perfect blend of modern style and warm island charm.

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining

The open kitchen and dining space make shared meals feel easy and enjoyable. Prepare a relaxed breakfast, brew your morning coffee, or cook dinner together — the space is fully equipped for everyday comfort and long, leisurely dining.

🛏️ Bedrooms

Padang Senang features three spacious and serene bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom for total privacy:

- Ground-floor bedroom overlooking the pool — ideal for guests wanting easy access

- Two upstairs suites with calming natural light and stylish décor

- Master suite with rain shower and a luxurious bathtub for slow, indulgent evenings

Every room is designed with soothing tones, plush linens, and thoughtful details that invite you to unwind.

🛁 Bathrooms

All bathrooms are ensuite and designed with clean lines, warm textures, and spa-inspired touches. Enjoy rain showers, soft lighting, quality amenities, and a relaxing bathtub in the master bathroom.

📍 Neighborhood & Location

Stay in the center of everything Uluwatu is loved for:

* Padang Padang Beach — 10-minute walk

* Bingin Beach — 1.7 km

* Moments from favorite cafés & restaurants: Ours Uluwatu, Rolling Fork, The Place With No Name, Bartolo

* A short drive to iconic beach clubs: El Kabron, Ulu Cliffhouse, Savaya

* Supermarkets, surf shops, gyms, convenience stores — all within quick reach

Whether you're exploring, dining out, or soaking in Bali’s surf culture, everything is right outside your door.

🏋️‍♀️ Fitness & Wellness

If staying active is part of your Bali rhythm, you’ll love the selection of studios nearby:

* Bambu Fitness Bali

* Health Club Uluwatu

* 360 MOVE

* Ulu Active

* The Space Bali

From strength training to yoga and recovery, the area offers everything to keep your body balanced and energized.

Villa Padang Senang is more than a place to stay — it’s a thoughtfully designed retreat where style, comfort, and the best of Uluwatu come together. From its brand-new interiors to its unbeatable location, Padang Senang is your gateway to beach days, good coffee, world-class surf, and unforgettable Bali memories.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests have full and exclusive access to the entire villa during their stay.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Daily cleaning keeps the villa fresh and welcoming
- Pool & garden maintenance 2–3x/week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- High-speed Wi-Fi for streaming and working
- Safety boxes for peace of mind
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at Padang Senang!

shortDesc: Rasakan harmoni antara semen ekspos modern yang elegan dan kehangatan kayu alami di oase 2 kamar tidur ini. Pelayanan manajer villa yang penuh dedikasi memastikan setiap keinginan Anda terpenuhi bahkan sebelum Anda memintanya.
description: Rasakan harmoni antara semen ekspos modern yang elegan dan kehangatan kayu alami di oase 2 kamar tidur ini. Pelayanan manajer villa yang penuh dedikasi memastikan setiap keinginan Anda terpenuhi bahkan sebelum Anda memintanya.
fullDesc:
Bersiaplah untuk terpukau oleh keanggunan arsitektur kontemporer di Chic Tropical Bingin. Villa 2 kamar tidur ini membuktikan bahwa kesederhanaan desain semen ekspos yang dipadukan dengan kayu jati alami mampu menghadirkan kemewahan visual yang tiada duanya.

Setiap ruang dirancang dengan kecermatan tinggi untuk kenyamanan maksimal. Dari kamar tidur utama yang megah dengan pencahayaan temaram, kamar mandi semi-terbuka bernuansa zen, hingga kolam renang privat yang menyegarkan, setiap momen di sini terasa istimewa.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Nilai 10 dari 10! Villanya jauh lebih spektakuler daripada di foto, dan pelayanan manajer villanya benar-benar luar biasa tak tertandingi. Beliau sangat perhatian pada setiap detail kecil. Tempat yang sempurna!"

Hanya beberapa menit dari pantai selancar Bingin yang terkenal dan titik matahari terbenam paling magis di Bali, Chic Tropical Bingin siap menyambut Anda dengan kehangatan tak tertandingi.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to TĀRA Bingin Villa, a stylish new two-bedroom retreat in the exclusive Blacksand Villas Bingin, perfectly located just minutes from the beach, cafés, and restaurants.

Enjoy a private pool, open living spaces, and a beautifully private terrace upstairs, complete with comfortable seating and an airy pergola for all-day relaxation.

Ideal for friends or families seeking privacy, style, and a prime location near Bali’s beaches and sunsets.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
**As with many popular areas in Bali, ongoing development is prevalent in Bingin. Please note that there is construction adjacent to and opposite the villa, which may result in daytime noise and potential privacy disturbances. This is expected to continue until the end of December. However, to accommodate this inconvenience, our nightly rates have been significantly discounted

Experience to TĀRA Bingin Villa, your stylish tropical hideaway just minutes from Bingin and Dreamland Beach. Perfect for a relaxed Bali escape, this brand-new 2-bedroom villa blends comfort, privacy, and effortless holiday vibes!

Start your mornings with a refreshing dip in your private pool surrounded by lush greenery, then ease into the day with a slow breakfast in the open living area. In the evenings, curl up for a cozy movie night and let the calm of the villa settle in.

Designed with comfort and style in mind, each bedroom features a king-size bed, a contemporary ensuite bathroom, and a dedicated TV for relaxed downtime. The open-plan kitchen and dining area provide everything you need for convenient at-home dining, complemented by modern finishes, wood, stone, and subtle tropical touches, that bring a premium, serene feel to the space.

Next to the upstairs bedroom, the private terrace awaits, thoughtfully designed for lounging and social moments, with comfortable seating, tropical accents, and an airy pergola, perfect for relaxing throughout the day.

With generous bedroom spaces, fast WiFi, Netflix, and seamless indoor–outdoor living, TĀRA Bingin Villa offers the ideal blend of comfort and style, perfect for friends, couples, or families looking to relax in the heart of Bali’s most iconic surf area.

📍 Location & Nearby Attractions
Nestled within the exclusive Blacksand Villas Bingin complex, the villa places some of Bali’s top spots right at your doorstep:

- Dreamland Beach – 3 min
- Bingin Beach – 6 min
- Bambu Fitness – 5 min
- El Kabron – 3 min

After sun-soaked beach days, sunset sessions, café hopping, or exploring Bali’s hidden gems, return to your private sanctuary and let TĀRA Bingin Villa welcome you back with comfort, style, and tropical serenity.

name: Umalas Estate – Grand 5BR Designer Haven Bordering Berawa
shortDesc: Ketika ukuran dan privasi menjadi prioritas tertinggi Anda, mahakarya arsitektur 5 kamar tidur di perbatasan Umalas dan Berawa ini siap memukau rombongan besar Anda dengan kolam renang 18 meter dan layanan concierge berkelas.
description: Ketika ukuran dan privasi menjadi prioritas tertinggi Anda, mahakarya arsitektur 5 kamar tidur di perbatasan Umalas dan Berawa ini siap memukau rombongan besar Anda dengan kolam renang 18 meter dan layanan concierge berkelas.
fullDesc:
Keluasan ruang, kemewahan tanpa batas, dan privasi paripurna mendefinisikan Umalas Estate. Terletak di perbatasan strategis antara ketenangan pedesaan Umalas dan gemerlap gaya hidup Berawa, properti megah 5 kamar tidur ini adalah standar tertinggi villa grup di Bali.

Di atas lahan estate yang luas terbentang kolam renang pribadi sepanjang 18 meter yang memesona, dikelilingi halaman rumput hijau terawat dan sunken lounge yang megah. Lima kamar tidur utama berukuran luas dilengkapi kamar mandi mewah marmer, menjamin kenyamanan setara suite hotel bintang lima bagi setiap tamu.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Mahakarya arsitektur yang luar biasa! Kolam renang 18 meter dan tamannya sangat luas, membuat seluruh rombongan kami betah berhari-hari. Tim staf dan concierge sangat sigap melayani segala kebutuhan kami!"

Nikmati layanan butler dan concierge berdedikasi tinggi yang siap mengatur santap malam chef privat, transportasi eksklusif, dan seluruh kebutuhan liburan Anda dengan kesempurnaan mutlak.

descriptionSections.body:
Located in Umalas just minutes from Berawa, Villa Ithaki is a striking five bedroom residence set on a generous ten are estate.

This thoughtfully designed retreat blends bold architecture with elevated comfort, offering a private pool, sauna, ice bath, dedicated spa room, TV corner, workspace, and an elegant bar for effortless entertaining.

Ithaki delivers a refined Bali experience where luxury, tranquility, and modern living come together in perfect harmony.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Villa Ithaki, a five-bedroom architectural hideaway set on a generous ten are in the peaceful, sought-after Umalas area. The villa brings together bold contemporary design, high-end comfort, and the calm rhythm of Bali’s tropical landscape in one seamless experience.

From the moment you enter, the atmosphere sets the tone. Push open the door and you’re greeted by stone walkways floating over koi ponds, with the soft echo of moving water around you. Ahead, a long stretch of manicured greenery pulls you deeper into the estate, building anticipation as the villa quietly reveals itself.

The main pavilion opens into a bright, expansive living area where natural light pours in from all sides. Views of the shimmering pool and lush surroundings anchor the space in tranquility. High ceilings, curated décor, and warm textures create a balance of sophistication and ease. To one side sits a fully equipped modern kitchen ideal for private dining or chef service, while the opposite end features a custom bar that naturally becomes the evening gathering spot.

Outside, the pool is the villa’s centerpiece. Framed by tropical plants, plush daybeds, and open sky, it’s designed for long, unhurried afternoons. A dedicated wellness wing enhances the sense of retreat, complete with a private massage room and a traditional sauna tucked away for quiet restoration.

The five bedrooms each offer comfort and thoughtful design:

• Primary Suite: King bed, two walk-in wardrobes, and a TV discreetly concealed in the bed frame, plus an en suite bathroom.
• Second Suite: Another king bed with generous space and an elegant en suite.
• Third Bedroom: Queen bed paired with a refined en suite.
• Fourth & Fifth Bedrooms: A family-friendly setup—one with a small double bed, the other with a single—linked by a shared bathroom with a bathtub ideal for kids.
• Children’s Playroom: A dedicated space for younger guests.

Just minutes from Berawa’s top restaurants, cafés, boutiques, and beach clubs, Villa Ithaki combines modern luxury with easy access to one of Bali’s most dynamic neighborhoods—an ideal choice for travelers seeking both elegance and connection to the island’s vibrant scene.

reviews.originalComment:
Tuvimos una estancia absolutamente increíble en villa Imala. Todo fue perfecto de principio a fin.
La villa es espectacular, con una vista impresionante desde la piscina que hace que cada momento sea especial, especialmente al atardecer. La ubicación es ideal: muy cerca de Savaya, de excelentes restaurantes y de algunas de las mejores playas de la zona.

reviews.name: Nicola
reviews.comment:
The house itself is gorgeous, proper wow factor and Setya and his team were fantastic. 
The pictures online show the house at the end of a row with trees beside it (this is AI) there is a house currently being built directly next door, work going on early mornings and late evenings. We were informed on booking that just the road was being updated so if we had known this we would probably have chosen a different property. Compared to our other 2 amazing villas we stayed in Canguu and Ubud this was 3x times more expensive per night! There was no air con in the living area due to it being part open air upstairs so we didn’t often sit in the lounge area due to it being too hot and humid. The outlook directly behind us was also very messy with rubble etc strewn everywhere.
On the last night we had issues with noise from partying next door until I went out at 4am and shouted at them to turn the music down! They said sorry and did as asked. Obvs didn’t have the same house rules as we did!
reviews.hostResponse:
Thank you, Nicola, for taking the time to share your feedback.
We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the villa itself and that Setya and our team contributed positively to your stay.
We are sorry that certain external factors impacted your overall experience. Unfortunately, nearby construction activity and occasional neighborhood noise are beyond our control, although we always do our best to keep guests informed of any known disruptions before arrival.
Regarding the villa’s design, the open-air living area is a common feature of many luxury tropical homes in Bali, created to maximize natural light, ocean views, and airflow. We understand that this style may not suit every traveler’s preference.
Thank you again for staying with us. Guest feedback helps us continuously improve both our communication and our guest experience and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back to Bali in the future.
The MIO team

reviews.name: Livio
reviews.comment:
The villa in Uluwatu is truly an absolute dream. Modern design, stylish furnishings and very high-quality amenities – you feel right at home as soon as you arrive. Everything was clean, well-maintained, and thought out in detail.
The atmosphere is perfect for relaxing while being productive – just my vibe. Especially the pool area and the entire architecture give you this luxurious Bali feeling that you need.
The management was also very professional, friendly and always helpful. The communication went smoothly and you felt well cared for at all times.
I can definitely recommend the villa and would come back anytime.
reviews.originalComment:
Die Villa in Uluwatu ist wirklich ein absoluter Traum. Modernes Design, stilvolle Einrichtung und eine sehr hochwertige Ausstattung – man fühlt sich direkt wohl, sobald man ankommt. Alles war sauber, gepflegt und bis ins Detail durchdacht.
Die Atmosphäre ist perfekt, um zu entspannen und gleichzeitig produktiv zu sein – genau mein Vibe. Besonders der Poolbereich und die gesamte Architektur geben einem dieses luxuriöse Bali-Feeling, das man sich wünscht.
Auch das Management war sehr professionell, freundlich und immer hilfsbereit. Die Kommunikation lief reibungslos und man hat sich jederzeit gut betreut gefühlt.
Ich kann die Villa definitiv weiterempfehlen und würde jederzeit wiederkommen.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Livio,
Thank you so much for your beautiful and detailed review. It truly means a lot to us.
We’re delighted to hear that you felt comfortable from the moment you arrived and that the design, atmosphere, and overall experience matched your vibe. Creating a space where our guests can both relax and feel inspired is exactly what we aim for.
It was a real pleasure hosting you, and we truly appreciate your kind words about our team and service. You are always welcome back at Villa Imala, we would be more than happy to host you again anytime.
Warm regards,
The MIO team

reviews.hostResponse:
