reviews.name: Martina
reviews.comment:
We had an absolutely amazing stay at this villa. Everything is brand new, and we were lucky enough to be the very first guests. The villa is beautiful, and the pool is fantastic, perfect for relaxing and spending time with friends.
Our favorite moment was definitely the sunset. Sitting on the terrace, enjoying the ocean view at the end of the day, was simply magical. Uluwatu is our favorite area in Bali, and this place truly exceeded our expectations.
The manager was outstanding and took great care of us, organizing massages, spa treatments, and even a special dinner. It was also a very special stay for me as I celebrated my birthday there with friends.
The access road is still being finalized, but once you’re inside the villa, you enjoy complete privacy and tranquility. We highly recommend this place and would love to come back.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Martina,
Thank you so much for this wonderful review. We’re truly happy you were our very first guests at Villa Imala and that you loved the brand-new villa, the huge pool, and those magical Uluwatu sunsets from the terrace.
It also means a lot to hear our manager helped make your birthday celebration special with massages, spa treatments, and a private dinner. Thanks as well for your understanding about the access road being finalized, we’re actively following up to have it completed as soon as possible.
We’d be delighted to welcome you and your friends back anytime.
The MIO team

description: Kemewahan tanpa batas menanti Anda di estate 6 kamar prestisius ini. Mulai hari Anda dengan sesi kebugaran di gym berdinding kaca panorama samudra, manjakan diri di ruang spa privat, dan saksikan senja keemasan dari kolam renang 80m² Anda.

spaceSections.title: The space
spaceSections.body:
VILLA IMALA — ULTRA-LUXURY 6BR OCEAN VIEW VILLA WITH SPA & GYM IN ULUWATU

Welcome to Villa Imala, a spectacular 6-bedroom luxury private villa in Uluwatu, offering ocean views, expansive living spaces, and exclusive wellness facilities, just minutes from Savaya, Melasti Beach, and Uluwatu’s most iconic coastline.

Perfect for families, groups of friends, and retreats, Villa Imala combines modern tropical design, total privacy, and five-star services to deliver a true resort-style experience in your own private villa.

SPACIOUS OPEN-PLAN LIVING DESIGNED FOR GROUP COMFORT
From the moment you enter, the villa welcomes you with wide open spaces, high ceilings, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The bright living area connects naturally to the pool deck and outdoor lounges.

80M² PRIVATE POOL & ROOFTOP WITH OCEAN VIEWS
At the heart of the villa lies your 80m² private swimming pool, surrounded by sun loungers and relaxed outdoor seating. The rooftop terrace features oversized daybeds and open views for sunset drinks.

PRIVATE SPA & PANORAMIC GYM
Enjoy a dedicated private spa room for in-villa massages and a glass-walled gym with panoramic views and ocean breeze.

spaceSections.title: Other things to note
spaceSections.body:
Included in every stay:
- Free welcome drink & cold towels
- Full daily housekeeping and dedicated villa manager
- High-speed fiber WiFi throughout villa
- Pool & garden maintenance
- Concierge services for transport, private chef, and Savaya reservations

shortDesc: Kemewahan tanpa batas menanti Anda di estate 6 kamar prestisius ini. Mulai hari Anda dengan sesi kebugaran di gym berdinding kaca panorama samudra, manjakan diri di ruang spa privat, dan saksikan senja keemasan dari kolam renang 80m² Anda.
fullDesc:
Selamat datang di puncak kemewahan Uluwatu. Villa Imala bukan sekadar villa mewah biasa—ini adalah resor privat pribadi bintang lima dengan fasilitas terlengkap di pesisir selatan Bali.

Bertengger anggun menghadap Samudra Hindia yang biru pekat, properti spektakuler 6 kamar tidur ini memiliki kolam renang raksasa seluas 80 meter persegi, rooftop terrace dengan daybed empuk untuk menikmati sunset, gym berdinding kaca dengan peralatan lengkap berpanorama laut, serta ruang spa privat khusus untuk perawatan tubuh Anda.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Villa Imala tidak ada tandingannya di seluruh Uluwatu! Kolam 80m², gym panorama laut, dan pemandangan rooftop benar-benar memukau seluruh rombongan kami. Pelayanan stafnya berkelas dunia dan memenuhi setiap permintaan kami dengan sempurna!"

Hanya beberapa menit dari Savaya Beach Club dan Pantai Melasti, Villa Imala menawarkan privasi absolut, prestise tanpa tanding, dan pengalaman liburan yang akan dikenang selamanya.

Rasakan perpaduan sempurna antara kehidupan pantai yang berkelas dan privasi rumah mewah di jantung Berawa.

descriptionSections.body: Escape to Villa Mahina, in one of Canggu’s most sought-after locations. Just 400m from Berawa Beach and minutes from Finns Beach Club, this stylish 3-bedroom villa sits in a private residence, offering peace and privacy while being close to Canggu’s best restaurants, cafés, and nightlife, including Mesa, Jade, and Vault. Enjoy a private pool, secure parking, spacious living areas, and double-glazed windows ensuring complete tranquility for a perfect Bali getaway.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
VILLA MAHINA – LUXURY 3BR VILLA WALKING DISTANCE TO BERAWA BEACH

Villa Mahina is a contemporary luxury 3-bedroom villa ideally located in the heart of Berawa, Canggu’s most sought-after neighborhood. Just 400 meters from Berawa Beach and moments away from Bali’s most vibrant lifestyle destinations, the villa offers the perfect balance between privacy, comfort, and immediate access to the island’s best beach clubs, restaurants, cafés, and nightlife.

Nestled within a private residence and set back from the main road, Villa Mahina provides a peaceful sanctuary while remaining at the center of everything that makes Canggu one of Bali’s most desirable destinations.

THREE PRIVATE BEDROOM SUITES

Designed with comfort and simplicity in mind, each bedroom features:

• Premium king-size bedding
• Private en-suite bathroom
• Elegant contemporary design
• Air conditioning
• Ample storage space

Bright and comfortable, the bedrooms offer a relaxing retreat after a day exploring Bali.

PRIVATE POOL & TROPICAL OUTDOOR LIVING

At the heart of the villa lies a private swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery and sun loungers.

Whether enjoying a morning coffee by the pool, an afternoon swim, or a sunset cocktail before heading to Berawa Beach, the outdoor space has been designed to embrace Bali’s tropical lifestyle.

SPACIOUS OPEN LIVING AREA

The villa’s generous living and dining area is enhanced by high ceilings that create an exceptional sense of space and natural light.

The open-plan design includes:

• Large lounge area
• Fully equipped modern kitchen
• Spacious dining area
• Seamless indoor-outdoor living

The result is a bright, airy, and welcoming atmosphere ideal for families, friends, and long stays.

PRIME BERAWA LOCATION

One of Villa Mahina’s greatest assets is its unbeatable location.

Within walking distance you will find:

• Berawa Beach (400m)
• Finns Beach Club
• Atlas Beach Club
• Mesa Restaurant
• Jedd
• Volt
• Trendy cafés, boutiques, gyms, and wellness centers

Enjoy Bali’s most spectacular sunsets, morning beach walks, world-class dining, and vibrant nightlife, all just minutes from your doorstep.

FIVE-STAR SERVICES

Our team is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and memorable stay with:

• Personalized check-in
• Daily housekeeping
• Concierge assistance
• Airport transfers
• Private chef services
• Spa and wellness experiences
• Tour and activity arrangements

IDEAL FOR

• Families
• Groups of friends
• Digital nomads
• Long stays
• Beach lovers
• Guests seeking both privacy and prime location

THE VILLA MAHINA EXPERIENCE

Villa Mahina combines contemporary design, spacious living, and one of the best locations in Bali. A private tropical retreat where you can enjoy the energy of Berawa and Canggu while returning home to complete peace, comfort, and privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body:
You will enjoy exclusive access to the entire Villa Mahina, ensuring complete privacy, comfort, and tranquility throughout your stay. Located within a private residence in the heart of Berawa, the villa offers a peaceful retreat just 400 meters from Berawa Beach and minutes from Canggu’s most iconic lifestyle destinations.

Relax by your private swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery, unwind on the sun loungers, or enjoy the spacious outdoor deck designed for Bali’s indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The villa also features a fully equipped modern kitchen, a generous dining area, and a bright open-plan living space with high ceilings that create an exceptional sense of space and natural light.

The villa features two full bathrooms: one private en-suite bathroom connected to the master bedroom, and one shared bathroom for the other two bedrooms. An additional guest toilet is conveniently located on the ground floor. Double-glazed windows help ensure a calm and restful atmosphere while being just moments away from the vibrant energy of Berawa.

Whether you are spending your days enjoying sunset walks on the beach, exploring Bali’s best restaurants and cafés, or simply relaxing by the pool, Villa Mahina has been designed to provide a seamless blend of luxury, privacy, and convenience in one of Bali’s most desirable locations.

The pantry was missing some basic amenities such as tea and sugar, and there was no microwave, which would have been a nice addition. It would also be thoughtful to provide basic toiletries such as toothpaste and toothbrushes for guests.
On the positive side, the bed was very comfortable, and the location is excellent. It is very convenient, close to many attractions, and easy to find.
Overall, the villa has great potential because of its beautiful design and excellent location. With better maintenance and a few additional amenities, it would provide an even better experience for guests.

reviews.name: 婕
reviews.comment:
The villa I stayed in this time was exactly as shown in the photos, and in fact, the actual place was even more stunning than the photos!Everyone was excited as soon as they walked in; it was truly beautiful.The house manager, Dando, was friendly and considerate throughout. Not only did he proactively greet us and help us carry our luggage, but he also carefully loaded our luggage into the car when we left. He was very easy to get along with, and I felt at ease whenever I saw him.
The room's swimming pool is clean and clear, but please be aware that the water depth is over 1.5 meters (about 5 feet), so please be careful.The kitchen was also very clean and tidy, and basic supplies such as drinking water were well stocked. We also took a lot of beautiful photos here.
There are many nice restaurants nearby, within walking distance.
The only downside is that the hot water isn't very reliable; it often runs out while I'm washing. Also, the hair dryer isn't very powerful, so it takes a long time to dry my hair.But overall, the experience was excellent. The thoughtful gesture of turning on the air conditioning in advance, especially before check-in, was a real plus. Highly recommended!

房间泳池干净清澈，唯一提醒下水深大概1.5米以上，注意安全。厨房也非常干净整洁，饮用水等基础用品都准备得很齐全，我们还在这里拍了非常多漂亮的照片。
附近有很多不错的餐厅，步行即可前往。
美中不足是热水不太稳定，洗着洗着容易不够；电吹风功率偏小，吹头发耗时比较久。但整体体验非常好，尤其入住前就提前开好空调的细节特别加分，强烈推荐！

reviews.comment:
Stayed here for the first 3 nights after arriving in Bali and LOVED it so much!! We arrived at night and were able to do self check-in without any problems. Host was always super responsive, very prompt & friendly.
What I loved about this place - 
1) Lots of sunlight during the day 
2) Decent sized pool - pretty deep too.. I’m 163cm tall and I couldnt stand on my feet which is great cuz my husband and I love swimming
3) Spacious place - it’s a 2BR villa but we booked it just for the two of us, so we used one room as a walk-in closet and the other for sleeping. Kitchen & dining area + outdoor living space were big & spacious! 
4) I was so so worried about mosquitoes and bugs since the villa has a lot of open space, but to my surprise, I didnt get a single mosquito bite!!! 
5) Photogenic! I wish i could share here some of the amazing photos we took… so pretty.
6) Location : walkable to most places in Canggu but away from the noise.. 
thx!!!!!! loved everything about this place!! 강추에요!!
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear You, Thank you so much for your truly wonderful review! We are absolutely delighted to hear that you LOVED your stay with us and that you had such a great time.
We're so happy that you appreciated so many of the unique features of our villa, from the lots of sunlight to the spacious living areas. It's also great to know that the deep pool was perfect for you and your husband, and that you were pleasantly surprised by the lack of mosquitoes! We also take pride in our service, so we're thrilled that your self-check-in was smooth and that our team was super responsive and friendly.
Thank you for your fantastic feedback on the location and for sharing your positive experience. We sincerely appreciate your high recommendation!
We can't wait to welcome you back again on your next trip to Bali!
Best regards, House of Reservations Management

reviews.name: Uchenna
reviews.comment: Beautiful villa within the heart of Changgu. The host was responsive enough, at times there were slight delays but, after a few calls and text he would be on top of it. Everything was perfect except there was no wifi in the villa that was steady or strong. The host gave us a hot spot but only one phone at a time could use it, if that. It hardly worked so we were out of wifi the whole stay, we used alot of data because of this. Also, there is no microwave, so we could not warm anything up or preserve something the next day to eat. Also, there was no hot water from the showers for more than 5 mins after that you’re forced to bathe in lie warm-cold water. Again, I would stay here again because of how beautiful and central it is but it does have its hiccups.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Uchenna Nebeolisa, Thank you so much for your detailed feedback and for choosing to stay with us. We're very happy to hear you enjoyed the beauty and central location of the villa.
We truly appreciate you pointing out the areas that could be improved. Regarding the Wi-Fi, we understand how important a stable connection is, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. The hotspot was provided as a temporary solution, and we're currently working on upgrading the Wi-Fi by adding an additional unit to ensure better coverage and speed throughout the villa.
As for the hot water, after checking, it is functioning normally—please note that it may take around 30 seconds for the water to heat up properly. We’ll make sure to communicate this more clearly to future guests.
Lastly, thank you for mentioning the microwave—we currently don’t provide one, but your suggestion is noted and we will consider adding it in the future to improve our amenities.
We truly value your comments and are glad to hear you’d still consider staying with us again. We hope to welcome you back with an even better experience next time!
Best regards, House of Reservations Management

reviews.name: Layla
reviews.comment:
Location: There are nice restaurants all on one road nearby and quiet and private at night.Just one day someone has a ring doorbell to raise a donation.I didn't understand to close the door fast.
Hygiene: Nice ending, very spacious and beautiful restroom, with two shower heads and two faucets in each bathroom which was great.We didn't have mosquitoes for two days.
Facilities: The kitchen is fully equipped, we cooked two meals and bought our own oil and salt.The two bedrooms were the same touches, and the space was large both of us staying was a bit of a waste of both of us staying haha.
Host Interaction: host is very nice, can help me rent a motorbike for 100k a day, no need any formalities, very convenient.No gas to add yourself.
Unique Highlights: Pretty Pool 100!There are also two landing mirrors at your leisure.
Surrounding fun: It's a lot better than Ubud, about 15mins from a few internet-famous restaurants motorcycles.Supermarket motorbike 5mins.
reviews.originalComment:
位置：附近一条路都有漂亮的餐厅，到了晚上很安静，私密性很好。就是有一天人有按门铃要募捐的。我说听不懂赶紧关门。
卫生：尾声很不错的，洗手间都非常宽敞漂亮，每个浴室都有两个莲蓬头和两个水龙头，非常好。住了两天没有蚊子。
设施：厨房齐全，我们做了两顿饭，自己要买油和盐。两间卧室是一摸一样的，空间都很大我们两个人住有点浪费了哈哈。
房东互动：host人很好，可以帮我租摩托车100k一天，不需要任何手续，非常方便。没油自己加。
独特亮点：漂亮的泳池100分！还有两面落地镜子随意拍拍
周边好玩：离几个网红餐厅摩托大概15mins路况比乌布是好很多了。超市摩托5mins。

shortDesc: Biarkan diri Anda terhanyut dalam kehangatan nuansa gurun pasir yang eksotis di jantung Canggu. Nikmati kesegaran berenang di bawah sinar mentari tropis dan sensasi mandi terbuka bernuansa spa alami yang merelaksasi setiap jengkal tubuh Anda.
description: Biarkan diri Anda terhanyut dalam kehangatan nuansa gurun pasir yang eksotis di jantung Canggu. Nikmati kesegaran berenang di bawah sinar mentari tropis dan sensasi mandi terbuka bernuansa spa alami yang merelaksasi setiap jengkal tubuh Anda.
fullDesc:
Temukan pelarian eksotis bernuansa padang pasir yang menawan di Khaleela Villas. Membawa inspirasi oasis gurun ke tengah semaraknya Canggu, villa 2 kamar tidur satu lantai ini menawarkan ketenangan visual yang jarang ditemui di tempat lain.

Dinding bernuansa terakota hangat dan lengkungan kurva khas timur tengah berpadu anggun dengan tanaman kaktus dan kolam renang pribadi yang jernih. Kamar mandi terbuka tropis dengan shower pancuran batu alam menghadirkan ritual mandi yang menyegarkan jiwa di bawah langit terbuka Bali.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Desainnya luar biasa memukau dan sangat menenangkan! Konsep oasis gurunnya sangat unik, stafnya sangat ramah dan sigap, dan lokasinya dekat dengan kafe-kafe favorit di Canggu. Liburan yang sangat menyenangkan!"

Hanya beberapa menit berkendara dari pantai selancar Batu Bolong dan Echo Beach, Khaleela Villas adalah tempat di mana estetika fotografi dan kenyamanan relaksasi berpadu sempurna.

descriptionSections.body: Discover Khaleela Villas, a desert-inspired oasis in vibrant Canggu. Its unique charm captivates with immersive desert vibes. This single-story haven boasts two cozy bedrooms for a serene retreat. Lounge by the refreshing pool, basked in sunlight. The fully equipped kitchen beckons culinary adventures. Unwind in the comfy living area, or bathe outdoors in harmony with nature. Find tranquility amidst the desert design, ensuring an unforgettable stay in Canggu.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Khaleela Villas is a desert-inspired sanctuary located in the bustling area of Canggu. The villa's unique design exudes the charm of the desert, creating a captivating and immersive experience. The single-story layout features two bedrooms, providing a comfortable and peaceful retreat for your stay.

The villa offers a refreshing swimming pool where you can cool off and unwind under the sun. The fully equipped kitchen provides all the necessary amenities for your culinary adventures. The comfortable living area is the perfect space to relax and unwind, while the outdoor shower allows you to connect with nature and enjoy a refreshing bathing experience.

Khaleela Villas offers a tranquil escape with its desert-inspired design and soothing pool views, providing a unique and unforgettable stay in Canggu.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The villa and pool will be reserved for you. There will be a host who will be your contact person during your stay. We have a team of housekeeping, a gardener, and a pool boy to ensure that the villa is in pristine condition.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
There is construction next door on the doorstep from 8 AM - 5 PM. It is hard to say if there will be noise during your stay.

Due to the possible daytime noise we are offering reduced rates. If it is too noisy for you during your stay, you can cancel your stay, and we will refund the nights you have not been staying.

Please adhere to the booking rules. The villa cannot be occupied by more guests than booked. Host approval is required for professional photography and additional terms may apply.

Friendly note
To comply with Indonesian government regulations, guests are required to complete and sign a short check-in form upon arrival and may be asked to present a valid ID. The form also includes house rules and the property's terms and conditions. By confirming your booking, you agree to this process during your stay.

The technology throughout the villa was such a fun touch — from the ability to connect and play music in different areas of the home to the automatic toilets with lids that opened on approach, heated seats, and automatic flushing. It honestly reminded me of the smart features we experienced in Singapore.
On top of that, the price felt like an absolute steal for the quality of the home, design, amenities, and overall experience.
A couple small notes: the home wasn’t ready right at arrival because the previous guests checked out late, and we wish we could have gotten the projector working. Even with those issues, the overall experience was excellent.We’d absolutely recommend

One of the living-room AC actually leaked water.
The doorman at the entrance were starting chatting at 7am with his friends that were probably visiting him… which makes it very not likeable knowing bathrooms where open and that it was right in front of doorman’s watching room.
The workers of the villa also were coming to make themselves a coffee or to have a drink in the pool house.
Cleaning was good ! Except the fact they wanted to charge us bed sheets because they got dirty… which was a bit confusing.
No lighting upstairs and fans weren’t working. Which made the rooftop unsuitable.
Very nice modern house !! I loved it.
It’s a shame it’s poorly maintained.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Rose,
Thank you for your feedback. While we’re glad you enjoyed the villa and its modern amenities, we need to clarify several points. The AC units are cleaned regularly, typically once a month, and no request was made during your stay to adjust this schedule. All AC units are now functioning properly. Our staff enter the villa only at agreed times with guests, and any perceived intrusion does not reflect a deviation from this policy. Regarding the bed sheets, the charge was applied due to a permanent mark caused by a tattoo, which made the sheets unusable; this fee remains valid despite it not being paid until today. The lighting and fans upstairs have now been repaired, and the rooftop is fully functional. We are proud to say that the villa is maintained very well. While we value guest input, we expect reviews to reflect the complete situation. Thank you.

reviews.name: Kylethan
reviews.comment:
The villa is very beautiful, we loved it but a few issues came up that made our stay unpleasant 
- air con in living room was leaking 
- cleaning staff did not provide new towels and had to ask for new ones for the master bedroom, they also removed the dirty towels from one of the rooms but did not replace with new towels, bath mats were soaking wet but not replaced. Toilet bins were full but not emptied 
- no body soap in master bedroom but instead hand soap was placed in the shower. 
- instead of conditioner, shampoo was placed in the conditioner bottle 
- toilet rolls not replenished 
- kitchen bins not emptied 
- staff did not know how to operate the projector 
- text messages were read but not replied to 
- first room on the first floor had issues with the lock, my friend was stuck in the room for 1.5h which disrupted our plans 
Overall I felt that for paying a premium price, the service was not satisfactory
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Kylethan,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We value all guest comments, as they help us maintain and improve our standards.
After reviewing the points raised, we’d like to offer some clarification. The air conditioning unit was not leaking; there was minor ice buildup, but it continued to function properly and has since been fully resolved. Our team performs thorough daily cleaning and replaces towels, amenities, and bin liners regularly. These services are not carried out multiple times a day unless specifically requested, to ensure guests’ privacy and comfort are respected during their stay.
The projector was fully functional, and our staff are always available to assist with its operation. Guests are welcome to reach out at any time for additional service or support, and our team is always happy to help.
Regarding communication, we always strive to respond as promptly as possible; however, please understand that response times may be slightly delayed during nighttime hours. As for the door issue, our villa manager responded within eight minutes and provided prompt assistance. The lock jam occurred after the mechanism was forced, but it was resolved in under an hour.
We appreciate the opportunity to clarify these details. While we regret that certain aspects of your experience did not meet expectations, we believe it’s important to ensure accurate information is shared. Our team remains committed to providing attentive service and a comfortable stay for every guest.

On top of that, when we first arrived there was some hair on our sheets which made me believe the sheets hadn’t been washed from the prior people in the villa. Finally at times there was large smells of sewage running through the property which the hosts could do nothing about.
The hosts were good enough and the villa was nice to look at but the above reasons means I won’t be staying here again.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Vikesh,
Thank you for your feedback. While we’re glad you found the villa visually pleasing, we’re disappointed to hear that other aspects of your stay didn’t meet your expectations.
We want to point out that our listing clearly states there is construction nearby, which typically doesn’t cause noise during the early hours you described. We find your comments unusual, but we will look into this to ensure there are no disturbances in the future.
Regarding cleanliness, we have strict standards, and our sheets are always freshly laundered before every guest's arrival and changed regularly throughout their stay. We are confident in our cleaning practices and believe your remarks may not accurately reflect the care we provide.
Concerning the smell, we took immediate action to address it once it was reported. We take pride in offering a comfortable stay for all our guests, and we feel your review doesn’t fully capture the efforts we put into ensuring your satisfaction.
Thank you for your feedback. We are committed to maintaining high standards and will continue to strive for excellence.

fullDesc:

Masuki gerbang villa dan Anda langsung disambut taman tropis megah dengan kolam renang seluas 45 meter persegi. Di dalam, nikmati TV 4K Smart 86 inci dengan sound system Sonos, dapur gourmet lengkap dengan peralatan SMEG, dan proyektor bioskop luar ruangan. Puncaknya adalah rooftop terrace yang dilengkapi jacuzzi hangat dan dek yoga dengan panorama matahari terbenam yang memukau.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:

Amankan pengalaman liburan paling canggih dan menyenangkan di Bali sekarang juga bersama keluarga dan sahabat terbaik Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Beyond the Palms!

This luxurious, high-tech 4-bedroom villa is perfect for anyone who wants a truly unforgettable Bali experience. We've designed it with privacy, comfort, and fun in mind. Whether you're a group of friends, a family, or a couple, you'll absolutely love everything Beyond the Palms has to offer.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
As you step into Beyond the Palms, you're instantly greeted by a massive garden area that leads to a stunning, crystal-clear 45sqm swimming pool. Relax on the sunbeds, play your favorite music through the outdoor speakers, take a refreshing swim, and make the most of your well-deserved break.
Enjoy a good BBQ? The outdoor area offers a private grill area just steps from the pool. It's the perfect place to prepare memorable meals and share them with your friends and family on the beautiful Bali evenings.

Step inside, head upstairs, and be wowed by the spacious living area. Huge panoramic windows offer amazing sunset views, best enjoyed from your extra comfy sofa. Not a big fan of sunsets? Enjoy your favorite movie on the premium 86-inch 4K Smart TV with its crystal-clear SONOS sound.

Cooking enthusiasts will love the fully equipped, state-of-the-art kitchen, complete with high-end appliances, SMEG gadgets, and a large island bench—perfect for creating culinary delights and enjoying them with loved ones.

The villa’s centerpiece is the terrace area, a guest favorite. Chill out on the huge sofa, watch movies on the projector with incredible surround sound, or unwind in the premium jacuzzi. And for those who enjoy staying active, the terrace’s yoga deck provides a tranquil space, especially magical during sunset.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests have exclusive access to all areas of the villa. Entry is seamless with an electronic code provided by our concierge during check-in.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Beyond the Palms is located in Canggu, close to all the best that Bali has to offer: 
5 min to Pepito (Grocery store)
5 min to Bali MMA and Wanderlust fitness village
6 min to Obsidian Gym
12 min to Finns Beach Club & Atlas club
13 min to Berawa Beach


**Parking Space**
Beyond the Palms offers a dedicated parking space with enough room for one car and several motorbikes.


** Tech You'll Love**
-  Multi-room audio system (indoor and outdoor)
-  High-speed Wi-Fi with amplifiers
-  86-inch 4K Smart TV in the living room with SONOS speaker
-  65-inch 4K Smart TV in the master bedroom with SONOS speaker
-  55-inch 4K Smart TVs in guest bedrooms
-  Projector with audio speakers & subwoofers
-  Premium kitchen appliances and SMEG gadgets
-  Jacuzzi

*** Privacy & Security ***
Guests' privacy is a top priority at Beyond the Palms, which is projected by villa designers and well-honored by the villa staff. For your extra safety, there is all-night security.

Please be advised that private chef services at the villa may only be arranged through our management team or with our prior written consent.

**Please note that there is construction work next door, which may cause some noise disturbance. This is expected to continue until the end of July 2027**

descriptionSections.body:
Discover Villa Akar, a contemporary four-bedroom villa set in one of Berawa’s most desirable pockets.

What awaits you:

- An unbeatable location near the beach and Berawa’s best hotspots
- Modern living spaces filled with natural light
- A dedicated team ensuring comfort from check-in to checkout

A refined Berawa stay, made effortless.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Villa Akar by Teduh is part of a curated collection of premium private villas in Berawa, Bali, designed for guests seeking privacy, design-led comfort, and a more elevated Bali stay. 

This polished four-bedroom hideaway set in the very heart of Berawa. Your arrival begins with the villa’s signature feature: a long, graceful pool that immediately captures your attention, its wide steps and sun loungers creating a natural place to settle in and unwind.

Just beside the pool, the main building opens into an elegant open-plan living area. The kitchen, dining space, and cozy lounge are arranged in one seamless sweep, framed by tall glass doors that can be fully opened to embrace the tropical breeze or closed to create a cool, quiet interior. The space is designed for easy living—perfect for relaxed mornings, shared meals, or evenings spent watching movies while surrounded by greenery and calming pool views.

Every bedroom at Villa Akar is designed with privacy and comfort in mind, each paired with its own en suite bathroom. The primary suite on the ground floor overlooks the pool and features a refined layout with a spacious bathroom and bathtub. The remaining bedrooms are positioned upstairs for added seclusion, including a second master suite that also enjoys the luxury of its own bathtub.

Blending understated elegance with a serene atmosphere and an unbeatable Berawa address, Villa Akar offers a luxurious setting for families and friends looking to enjoy a distinguished Bali retreat.

descriptionSections.body: Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

description: Kemudahan akses gaya hidup premium Berawa berada tepat di depan pintu Anda. Berada persis di seberang FINNS Recreation Club, villa 2 kamar modern chic ini menyuguhkan interior menawan dan kolam renang privat yang memanjakan liburan Anda.
fullDesc:
Nikmati kenyamanan tinggal di titik nol gaya hidup Berawa. Villa Golden terletak tepat di seberang FINNS Recreation Club, memberikan Anda akses instan ke arena olahraga terbaik, kafe kelas dunia, waterpark, dan lapangan tenis, sembari tetap menikmati privasi villa pribadi Anda.

Villa 2 kamar tidur bergaya modern chic ini memancarkan pesona interior mewah dengan sentuhan kayu hangat dan marmer elegan. Kedua kamar tidur memiliki kamar mandi en-suite berkelas, dan ruang tamu terbuka mengarah langsung ke kolam renang pribadi yang jernih.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Lokasi yang sangat sempurna di Berawa! Tinggal menyeberang jalan sudah sampai di FINNS Club, sangat dekat dengan kafe-kafe trendi. Villanya bersih berkilau, kolam renangnya sejuk, dan stafnya sangat membantu!"

Pilihan ideal bagi pasangan atau sahabat yang ingin menikmati dinamika terbaik Berawa tanpa repot bermacet-macetan.

descriptionSections.body:
Nestled in the vibrant Berawa neighborhood, Villa Golden offers a luxurious retreat for discerning travelers.

What to expect:
- Beautiful design and architecture
- located just across from FINNS recreation club
- Literally in the heart of Canggu, few meters away from all the best Canggu cafes and restaurants

The villa is fully equipped and staffed so you don't have to worry about a thing!

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Experience the epitome of luxury living at Villa Golden, a meticulously designed 2-bedroom en-suite villa perfectly situated in the heart of Berawa, directly facing the renowned FINNS recreation club. 

Upon entering Villa Golden, guests are greeted by a chic and inviting atmosphere, with contemporary furnishings and tasteful decor adorning the spacious interior. Each of the two bedrooms features its own en-suite bathroom, offering privacy and comfort for all guests. 

The villa's fully equipped kitchen provides a haven for culinary enthusiasts, complete with modern appliances and ample countertop space. Whether you're whipping up a quick breakfast or preparing a gourmet feast, the kitchen caters to all your culinary needs.

The stylish living areas are ideal for relaxation and entertainment, featuring comfortable sunken seating arrangements and state-of-the-art entertainment systems. Floor-to-ceiling windows allow for abundant natural light, creating a bright and airy ambiance throughout the villa.

In addition to its impeccable interior, Villa Golden offers the convenience of dedicated staff members who provide daily cleaning services, ensuring that your stay is as effortless as it is indulgent.

Step outside to discover the villa's private outdoor space, where a tranquil oasis awaits. Lounge by the sparkling pool, unwind in the cozy seating area, ideal for moments of relaxation and contemplation amidst nature's beauty.

Located in a bustling neighborhood just steps away from FINNS recreation club, Villa Golden offers easy access to an array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, this exquisite villa provides the perfect base for exploring all that Berawa has to offer.

Indulge in the ultimate luxury getaway at Villa Golden, where every detail has been meticulously crafted to ensure an unforgettable experience of refined elegance and unparalleled comfort.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request 
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

reviews.name: Manish
reviews.comment:
The villa is absolutely beautiful, one of the most beautiful places I’ve ever stayed in. The host is very warm and welcoming. The house is extremely well equipped and had everything we needed: first-aid supplies, filtered drinking water, bathrobes, TVs and tissues in every room, and hairdryers in each room.
When we arrived, the pool was dirty and not functional due to previous guests, but to the host’s credit, it was cleaned and fixed the very next day. Still had some algae tho!
The property itself feels run down in several areas. Shower pressure and water flow were extremely poor in some rooms, with visible mold in the shower grout. There was also a leaking tap trap and dirty bedding in one room on arrival-issues that should have been resolved before check-in.
The biggest issue, however, is the location. The access roads are in very poor condition- so bad that cabs cannot reach the villa requiring a ~200 m walk with luggage, which is highly inconvenient.
reviews.hostResponse:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback, Manish. We’re delighted to hear that you found the villa beautiful and appreciated the warm welcome and the well-equipped amenities.
We sincerely apologize for the issues during your stay. We take these matters seriously and are reviewing our maintenance and housekeeping procedures to prevent similar issues in the future.
Regarding the villa’s access, the road is still unpaved, but cars can reach the property. We understand that the condition of the road may feel inconvenient, and we always advise guests so they can plan accordingly.
We truly value your feedback, as it helps us improve, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back under even better conditions.

reviews.comment:
The team communicated well, but I strongly advise against booking this property. The house is completely run down: bedding and towels had heavy stains, the bathroom reeked of a disgusting smell, and water problems were constant — including no water at times and dirty water from the tap.
The windows have huge gaps, and worst of all, there is zero privacy. Farmers and children regularly walk directly past the bedroom and pool, staring in. You cannot relax here — there is no privacy anywhere on this property.
This place is not suitable for guests and should not be listed in its current condition
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Philip,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re pleased you appreciated our team’s communication and regret the inconveniences you encountered during your stay.
The water disruption was caused by an area-wide electricity outage beyond our control, and normal supply resumed as soon as the issue was resolved. Regarding privacy, the villa’s open design; which many guests value for its views of the rice fields; is located in a traditional Balinese area where occasional passersby can be seen. We’ve recently added a bamboo fence to improve seclusion, and our team monitors it to help maintain guest comfort.
We conduct thorough checks on bedding, towels, plumbing, and overall cleanliness before each arrival and act promptly on any concerns raised during a stay. While most guests enjoy the villa’s open layout and peaceful surroundings, we’ll take your comments into consideration to see where we can further enhance the experience.
Thank you again for your input; it helps us continue improving for our guests.

reviews.name: Pierre-Olivier
reviews.comment:
The owner mentioned in his listing that "farmers may be required to cultivate their rice field in front of the house"
We came across workers building a wall by the pool.
As soon as we wake up and open the curtains of our rooms, we are face to face with several people who work AT THE EDGE of your pool and look at you throughout the day. So no privacy, impossible for us to relax, impossible for my wife to put on a swimsuit, etc.
These workers are not aggressive but when you rent a private house it's to relax and have privacy!
We left after the 1st night because it was impossible for us to relax and have a decent vacation.
This is a shame because the villa and its pool are very pretty even if difficult to access.
We are still waiting for the refund of the nights following this inconvenience but we have not received any compensation to date
reviews.originalComment:
Le propriétaire mentionné dans son annonce que « des agriculteurs peuvent être amenés à cultiver leur rizière devant la maison »
Nous sommes tombés sur des travailleurs qui montaient un mur au bord de la piscine .
Dès le réveil en ouvrant les rideaux de nos chambres , nous moles nez à nez avec plusieurs personnes qui travaillent AU BORD de votre piscine et vous regarde tout au long de la journée . Donc aucune intimité , impossible pour nous de se détendre , impossible pour ma femme de se mettre en maillot de bain,…
Ces travailleurs ne sont pas agressifs mais quand vous louez une maison privative c’est pour se détendre et avoir de l’intimité !
Nous sommes partis après la 1ere nuit car il était impossible pour nous de nous détendre et passez des vacances convenables.
Cela est dommage car la villa et sa piscine sont très jolies même si difficile d’accès .
Nous sommes toujours en attente du remboursement des nuites suite à ce désagrément mais nous n’avons à ce jour reçu aucun dédommagement
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Pierre, we’d like to clarify the situation you mentioned. The work you observed was on the irrigation area next to the rice field, which is essential for local farmers and outside the villa grounds. The workers were never inside the villa, and the property has remained private and secure at all times. This was a temporary, short-term situation and has since been completed.
The villa and pool are fully private for guests to enjoy, and this was an exceptional occurrence. We’re glad you recognized the villa’s beauty, and we are confident that future guests will experience the relaxing stay that we are known for.

fullDesc:
Ketika Anda melangkahkan kaki melewati gapura batu tradisional Bali di Villa Surga, Anda seketika tahu bahwa Anda telah tiba di tempat yang istimewa. Sesuai namanya, villa ini adalah surga privat di mana keheningan alam Ubud menjadi pelindung Anda dari kepenatan dunia.

Menghadirkan 4 kamar tidur luas dengan kamar mandi terbuka en-suite, villa ini dirancang untuk menyerap keindahan alam sekitarnya. Infinity pool pribadi membentang menghadap lembah hijau tropis yang rimbun, menjadi tempat terbaik untuk bermeditasi, membaca buku, atau sekadar berendam menikmati udara segar pegunungan.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Ketenangan yang sesungguhnya di Ubud! Pemandangan lembah hijaunya begitu menenangkan mata dan jiwa. Seluruh staf melayani kami dengan tulus dari hati, menyiapkan sarapan lezat, dan menjaga villa tetap bersih berkilau. Liburan yang sangat damai!"

Rasakan keajaiban spiritual dan kenyamanan total di jantung budaya Bali bersama orang-orang tercinta Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Villa Surga, a private 4-bedroom villa tucked into the lush surroundings of Ubud — ideal for families and groups seeking space, comfort, and a peaceful tropical setting close to Bali’s cultural heart.

The villa features a private swimming pool, generous shared living areas, and full villa staffing, allowing you to relax from the moment you arrive. Whether you’re here to slow down, explore Ubud, or spend quality time together, it offers a calm and comfortable base for your stay.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Enter through a traditional Balinese gate into your own secluded sanctuary, designed for easy living and relaxation.

The villa includes four spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, offering privacy and comfort for every guest. Bedrooms are thoughtfully furnished with plush bedding, ample storage, air conditioning, and soft lighting to ensure restful nights. The en-suite bathrooms feature modern finishes, rain showers, and quality bath amenities.

At the center of the villa is the private swimming pool, surrounded by a sun deck where guests can relax, swim, or enjoy quiet moments throughout the day.

The open-plan living area provides a comfortable space for gathering, with generous seating and a relaxed indoor-outdoor layout. A fully equipped kitchen allows you to prepare meals at your convenience, or you may arrange a private cook through our concierge for an effortless dining experience.

High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the villa, making it suitable for both leisure stays and remote work when needed.

Villa Surga is especially well-suited for families or groups of friends who value privacy, shared spaces, and a tranquil environment while remaining within easy reach of Ubud’s temples, cafés, and cultural attractions.

Please note: local farmers may occasionally pass along a nearby footpath to access rice fields, offering an authentic glimpse into daily Balinese life.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The villa is completely private and only accessible by you.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:
-Free welcome drink
-Daily housekeeping
-Bath towels for each guests
-High Speed Wifi internet connection
-Safety boxes
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Breakfast upon request
-Private cook
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool Fence
-Laundry 
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villas!

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam mahakarya arsitektur tropis di mana batas antara alam dan kemewahan modern melebur sempurna. Dirancang oleh Biombo Architects yang tersohor, House Terra bukan sekadar villa—ini adalah tempat perlindungan pribadi Anda di Pererenan yang dirancang untuk mengembalikan ketenangan batin Anda.

Begitu Anda menginjakkan kaki di atas lantai batu alam yang sejuk, gemericik air kolam renang pribadi dan aroma frangipani seketika menyambut indera Anda, menghapus segala penat perjalanan. Dengan 5 kamar tidur en-suite yang luas, ruang santai beralaskan kayu jati hangat, piano klasik, dan area lounge outdoor yang teduh, setiap sudut dirancang untuk menciptakan momen tak terlupakan bersama keluarga dan sahabat tercinta.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Sebuah mahakarya arsitektur di Pererenan di mana setiap detail memancarkan kemewahan yang effortless dan kedamaian total. Kolam renang, ruang terbuka yang lapang, dan kehangatan tim staf membuat liburan Bali kami benar-benar sempurna. Nilai 10 dari 10!"

Ketika Anda memilih tinggal di House Terra, Anda mengamankan privasi eksklusif di lokasi paling diminati di Pererenan—hanya beberapa menit berjalan kaki dari kafe artisan terbaik dan pesisir pantai eksotis, namun terisolasi damai dari kebisingan dunia luar.

descriptionSections.body: "Such an incredible home, even better than the photos!" That is how guests describe House Terra, a 5-bedroom tropical villa in the heart of Pererenan. Every one of its 17 reviews is five stars, and it carries Airbnb's Guest Favorite badge with perfect 5.0 scores for cleanliness, accuracy and check-in.

descriptionSections.title: Why guests love it
descriptionSections.body:
• Design that stops you in your tracks: "The interior design and overall architecture is simply unbelievable."
• Exactly as pictured: "The house is literally just like the photos, nicely built, very spacious, and super comfy."
• Spotless inside and out, with daily cleaning by the villa staff.
• A team guests keep thanking: "exceptional staff who are friendly and helpful" and a host who was "really helpful at all hours."
• Made for groups: "Great place for large group to gather."

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Life here centres on a sunken living lounge with a bespoke curved sofa, framed by indoor gardens and tall glass that opens straight onto the lawn. A long turquoise pool runs the length of the villa, bordered by tropical greenery, with a BBQ lounge and outdoor dining table alongside.

The open-plan kitchen and long dining table are built for shared meals. Guests have booked in-villa chefs for breakfast and dinner, and one group called the dinner "one of the best we had throughout our stay in Bali."

A separate media room has a large screen, a deep sofa and a piano, and can double as an extra sleeping area.

descriptionSections.title: Bedrooms
descriptionSections.body: Five bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, sleeping up to 12 guests. Four have king-size beds, and the fifth suits families with two single beds and bunk beds. Bedrooms open onto the garden, the pool or a jungle-view terrace, and the house has 5.5 bathrooms in total.

descriptionSections.title: Included in every stay
descriptionSections.body:
• Welcome drink on arrival
• Villa staff with daily cleaning
• Bath towels for each guest
• High-speed Wi-Fi and air conditioning
• Safety boxes
• Concierge service

descriptionSections.title: On request through the concierge
descriptionSections.body: Airport transfer, car rental with or without driver, bike rental, breakfast, in-villa massage, nanny service, pool fence, laundry, restaurant bookings, and activities from surf lessons and cooking classes to temple and village tours.

descriptionSections.title: Location
descriptionSections.body: Set in the village of Pererenan, close to beaches, cafés and local markets while staying quiet at home. Guests rate the location 4.9.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The entire villa is yours, with full access and complete privacy.
